confidentialityNote.en: *Metrics are rounded or abstracted for confidentiality.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *基於保密考量，數據已四捨五入或以約略值呈現。*

publicSummary.en: Led evidence synthesis, customer-journey and system framing, interaction design and reusable component modelling; long-term mechanics, phasing and programme priorities were decided with product, business, operations, research, engineering and Design System partners.
publicSummary.zh: 主導證據統整、顧客旅程與系統定義、互動設計及可重用元件模型；長期機制、分階段策略與計畫優先順序則與產品、商務、營運、研究、工程及設計系統夥伴共同決定。

ledByMe.en: End-to-end evidence synthesis across research and shipped initiatives
ledByMe.zh: 跨研究與已上線子專案的端到端證據統整

ledByMe.en: Four-scenario journey/task-flow modelling and voucher-structure definition
ledByMe.zh: 建立四種情境的旅程與任務流程，並定義優惠券結構

ledByMe.en: Customer-facing interaction, state and recovery design for owned initiatives
ledByMe.zh: 負責子專案的顧客互動、狀態與失敗復原設計
建立優惠券卡片與可重用元件模型
整理可公開的證據與系統敘事

coDecided.en: Long-term reward mechanism and transition direction
coDecided.zh: 長期獎勵機制與轉換方向
商業規則對齊與計畫分期

coDecided.en: Formal Design System adoption and governance
coDecided.zh: 正式納入設計系統及其治理方式

partnerOwned.en: Research recruitment and specialist research facilitation
partnerOwned.zh: 研究招募與專業研究執行

partnerOwned.en: Business funding, campaign and operational rules
partnerOwned.zh: 商業預算、活動與營運規則

ownershipDetail.en: Led the campaign-flow and state design; the preloaded-wallet release direction was aligned with PM, business and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導活動流程與狀態設計；Preloaded-wallet 上線方向則與產品經理、商務及工程共同對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led the phased recovery model with the PM and owned the interaction, state and message design.
ownershipDetail.zh: 與產品經理共同主導分階段復原模型，並負責互動、狀態與訊息設計。

ownershipDetail.en: Led the hypothesis, prototype and product-page experience; business problem definition and rollout were aligned with business, PM and research.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導假設、原型與商品頁體驗；商業問題與推行則與商務團隊、產品經理及研究團隊對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Owned the interaction structure and shipped-state specification.
ownershipDetail.zh: 負責互動結構與已上線狀態規格。

ownershipDetail.en: Led the condition and channel action model; feasibility and business rules were jointly resolved with PM and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導條件與通路操作模型；可行性與商業規則則與產品經理及工程團隊共同解決。

ownershipDetail.en: Prepared the evidence, mechanism comparison and transition model; the long-term mechanism and phasing were programme decisions shared with product, business, operations and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理證據、機制比較與轉型模型；長期機制及分階段策略則由產品、商務、營運及工程共同決定。

ownershipDetail.en: Led channel-constraint and customer-friction analysis; the final mechanism direction required shared business and engineering approval.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導通路限制與顧客阻力分析；最終機制方向需由商務與工程共同核准。

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led early card exploration and translated cross-team feedback into responsive variants; formal component adoption was completed with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 共同主導早期卡片 探索，將跨團隊回饋轉化為響應式版本；正式元件採用則與設計系統團隊 共同完成。

ownershipDetail.en: Led evidence synthesis and information-priority recommendations; final visual semantics were aligned with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導證據統整與資訊優先建議；最終視覺語意與設計系統團隊對齊。

ownershipDetail.en: Defined the cross-journey property and state requirements; component API and governance were resolved with Design System and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 定義跨旅程屬性與狀態需求；元件 API 與治理則與設計系統及工程團隊共同解決。

ownershipDetail.en: Mapped operational rules and reusable states; final configuration ownership and governance were shared with operations, product, engineering and Design System.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理營運規則與 可重用 狀態；最終 設定 責任歸屬 與治理則由營運團隊、產品團隊、工程團隊及設計系統共同承擔。

claim.en: In a nine-participant wallet study, no participant used search during the tasks even though five later rated it as important.
claim.zh: 在 9 人錢包測試中，任務期間無人使用搜尋，但事後有 5 人將搜尋評為重要功能。

claim.en: Observed shopping behaviour started from products and categories rather than from the voucher wallet, supporting contextual discovery over wallet-first design.
claim.zh: 觀察到顧客從商品與品類開始購物，而不是先進入優惠券錢包，支持採用情境式探索。

claim.en: Voucher taxonomy, wallet, contextual offer surfaces, auto-apply, cart matching, code redemption and supplier-funded modules launched and continued to be used.
claim.zh: 優惠券分類、錢包、情境式優惠入口、自動套用、購物車配對、優惠碼兌換及供應商贊助模組皆已上線並持續使用。

claim.en: A campaign snapshot recorded substantial drop-off between payment entry, adding a voucher and applying all vouchers.
claim.zh: 特定活動資料顯示，從付款入口到新增優惠券，再到套用全部優惠券之間存在明顯流失。

heroVisualBrief.problemSignal: Fragmented discovery, eligibility and redemption across the journey
heroVisualBrief.systemSignal: Wallet, PDP/cart guidance and shared voucher-card/state model
heroVisualBrief.outcomeSignal: Reusable incentive capabilities across customer and supplier-funded journeys

title.en: Cross-channel rule fragmentation
title.zh: 跨通路規則分散

description.en: Rules evolved separately across online, in-store, and supplier-funded journeys, creating inconsistent terminology, states, and exceptions.
description.zh: 線上、門市與供應商出資旅程各自發展規則，造成用語、狀態與例外處理不一致。

title.en: Multi-party priorities
title.zh: 多方目標並存

description.en: Customer value, supplier visibility, campaign goals, and operational feasibility had to coexist within the same incentive model.
description.zh: 顧客價值、供應商曝光、活動目標與營運可行性必須共存於同一套獎勵模型。

title.en: Reuse depended on rule clarity
title.zh: 重用仰賴規則清晰

description.en: Eligibility, claim, expiry, redemption, and sponsorship logic had to be consistently defined before teams could safely reuse product patterns.
description.zh: 資格、領取、到期、兌換與出資邏輯必須先被一致定義，團隊才能安全重用產品模式。

intervention.en: Shared voucher rules and decision layer
intervention.zh: 共用優惠券規則與決策層

after.en: Consistent behaviour across product, cart, checkout, wallet, and store journeys
after.zh: 商品、購物車、結帳、票券錢包與門市旅程能一致運作

supportingCopy.en: I connected recurring voucher rules, states, and interactions across journeys so teams could build on a shared product foundation instead of redefining them for each touchpoint.
supportingCopy.zh: 我將不同旅程中反覆出現的優惠券規則、狀態與操作整理成共用產品基礎，讓團隊不必在每個接觸點重新定義。

title.en: Building a shared voucher model across the shopping journey
title.zh: 建立貫穿購物旅程的共享優惠券模型

atAGlance.en: Led a three-year cross-channel incentive programme, aligning voucher rules and shipping reusable capabilities across product, cart, checkout, wallet and in-store journeys.
atAGlance.zh: 主導為期三年的跨通路獎勵計畫，對齊優惠券規則，並在商品、購物車、結帳、票券錢包與門市旅程交付可重用能力。

whyItMattered.en: Each campaign and channel used its own Voucher rules and states, so growing the programme increased repeated interpretation, inconsistent customer behaviour and delivery risk.
whyItMattered.zh: 各活動與通路使用不同的優惠券規則與狀態，使計畫規模愈大，重複解讀、顧客體驗不一致與交付風險也愈高。

businessImpact.en: Reduced campaign-by-campaign reinterpretation by making shared rules, states and component mappings the default reference for incentive planning and delivery.
businessImpact.zh: 讓共享規則、狀態與元件對應成為獎勵計畫與交付的預設依據，降低每次活動都需重新解讀的依賴。

scope.en: Five-stage cross-channel journey covering product discovery, cart, checkout, Voucher Wallet and in-store redemption.
scope.zh: 涵蓋商品探索、購物車、結帳、優惠券錢包與門市兌換的五階段跨通路旅程。

audience.zh:
主要：在購物旅程中使用優惠券的顧客

sharedBoundary.zh: 機制、分階段策略與優先順序由跨職能夥伴共同決定。

scope.en: Five-stage cross-channel journey covering product discovery, cart, checkout, Voucher Wallet and in-store redemption.
scope.zh: 涵蓋商品探索、購物車、結帳、優惠券錢包與門市兌換的五階段跨通路旅程。

audience.en:
Primary: Customers using Vouchers across shopping journeys
Secondary: Sponsors and Operations teams funding, configuring and managing Voucher programmes
audience.zh:
主要：在購物旅程中使用優惠券的顧客
次要：出資、設定與管理優惠券計畫的贊助單位與營運團隊

scaleEvidence.unit_zh: 張旗艦活動 App 內優惠券

criticalProblem.en: Each campaign and channel used its own Voucher rules and states, so growing the programme increased repeated interpretation, inconsistent customer behaviour and delivery risk.
criticalProblem.zh: 各活動與通路使用不同的優惠券規則與狀態，使計畫規模愈大，重複解讀、顧客體驗不一致與交付風險也愈高。

primary.zh: 在購物旅程中使用優惠券的顧客

secondary.en: Campaign Operations teams configuring and managing Vouchers
secondary.zh: 負責設定與管理優惠券的活動營運團隊

publicRoleLine.zh: 計畫設計負責人・主導系統定義與旅程設計；機制與優先順序由跨職能共同決定。

voucher.scaleEvidenceRule: Show only evidence that materially improves hiring evaluation; do not fill a fixed card count.

audienceUsageBoundary.zh: 贊助單位影響計畫出資與規則，營運團隊負責設定與管理交付；不得暗示贊助單位自助設定已上線。

ledScope.en: System framing and cross-channel journey design
ledScope.zh: 系統定義與跨通路旅程設計

sharedBoundary.en: Mechanics, phasing and priorities were co-decided with cross-functional partners.
sharedBoundary.zh: 機制、分階段策略與優先順序由跨職能夥伴共同決定。

displayLine.en: Programme Design Lead · System framing and cross-channel journey design
displayLine.zh: 計畫設計負責人・系統定義與跨通路旅程設計

scaleDisplay.renderRule: Render only launch breadth, active usage breadth, organisational deployment or materially differentiating system coverage.
excludedEvidence: Device count unless it proves materially different product coverage

evidenceSummary.en: A 10-customer study showed stronger recall when Voucher and promotion value appeared together; the Eligible Voucher swimlane later shipped.
evidenceSummary.zh: 10 位顧客的研究顯示，優惠券與促銷價值集中呈現時更容易被記住；適用優惠券橫向內容列後續正式上線。

title.en: From separated promotions to one contextual deal view
title.zh: 從分散的促銷資訊，到同一個商品情境中的優惠總覽

evidenceSummary.en: The programme sequenced discovery, terminology and eligibility before broader automation; Collect and Online Grocery Select all were implemented while full cross-channel automation remained incomplete.
evidenceSummary.zh: 計畫先推進探索、用語與資格判斷，再逐步走向更廣泛的自動化；收集與線上購物全選已實作，完整跨通路自動化尚未完成。

title.en: From a big-bang mechanic replacement to an incremental transition
title.zh: 從一次性全面替換，到漸進式轉型

evidenceSummary.en: Engineering implemented the shared component and Operations setup automatically mapped Voucher types to the corresponding card variants.
evidenceSummary.zh: 工程團隊實作共享元件，營運設定流程也能依優惠券類型自動對應相應卡片版本。

title.en: From recurring Engineering clarification to rule-mapped Operations reuse
title.zh: 從反覆向工程團隊確認，到規則對應的營運團隊重用

reason.en: Important exception-handling evidence, but narrower than the programme's three system-defining decisions.
reason.zh: 屬於重要例外處理證據，但範圍小於三項定義整體系統的主要決策。

reason.en: Strong product iteration evidence; retained inside the Voucher Details evolution disclosure.
reason.zh: 屬於有力的產品迭代證據，保留於優惠券詳情演進的佐證資料中。

reason.en: System detail supporting the contextual and transition decisions.
reason.zh: 作為情境式決策與漸進轉型的系統細節佐證。

reason.en: Component-level trade-off; shown inside system-foundation evidence.
reason.zh: 屬於元件層級取捨，放入系統基礎佐證。

reason.en: Visual semantics supporting the component system, not a separate programme-level decision.
reason.zh: 屬於支援元件系統的視覺語意，不另列為計畫層級決策。

reason.en: Detailed implementation contract supporting Operations-configured reuse.
reason.zh: 支援營運配置重用的詳細實作契約。

decisionNarrative.primaryRenderRule: Resolve each sourcePath and render the source decision in this order. Do not duplicate or rewrite the source decision in the component.
decisionNarrative.supportingRenderRule: Supporting decisions are hidden from the primary page flow and appear only in the existing supporting-evidence disclosure.

intro.en: Three programme-level decisions summarise how customer evidence became product direction, transition strategy and a repeatable operating model.
intro.zh: 三項計畫層級決策總結顧客證據如何轉化為產品方向、轉型策略與可重複運作模型。

purpose.en: Show how programme-level evidence translated into a sequence of customer problems, shipped interventions and linked initiative details.
purpose.zh: 呈現計畫層級證據如何轉化為各旅程階段的顧客問題、已上線改善與可深入查看的子專案。

title.en: Surface relevant value while customers are already shopping
title.zh: 在顧客購物當下呈現相關優惠

criticalProblem.en: Customers usually began with products, categories or store tasks—not the Voucher Wallet—so relevant value was easy to miss.
criticalProblem.zh: 顧客通常從商品、分類或門市任務開始，而不是先進入優惠券錢包，因此容易錯過相關優惠。

decisionDirection.en: Move discovery into product, search, campaign and in-store contexts instead of relying on Wallet-first behaviour.
decisionDirection.zh: 將探索入口帶入商品、搜尋、活動與門市情境，而不是依賴顧客先進入錢包。

label.zh: 商品頁情境式優惠券探索

summary.en: Placed relevant Voucher value at a high-intent product touchpoint and shipped the Eligible Voucher swimlane.
summary.zh: 在高購買意圖的商品接觸點呈現優惠券價值，並上線適用優惠券橫向內容列。

label.en: Voucher Wallet discovery and Search decision
label.zh: 優惠券錢包探索與搜尋決策

summary.en: Observed behaviour supported Tabs, Filters and contextual entry before universal Wallet Search.
summary.zh: 觀察行為支持先強化分頁、篩選與情境式入口，而不是優先開發通用錢包搜尋。

label.zh: Save Everyday 數位年度活動

summary.en: Connected offline and in-app campaign discovery to saving and digital redemption.
summary.zh: 將線下與 App 內活動探索串接至儲存與數位兌換。

title.en: Make eligibility and value clear before commitment
title.zh: 在顧客投入前說清楚資格與價值

criticalProblem.en: Customers had to interpret product, channel, spend, expiry and stackability rules before knowing whether a Voucher applied or was worth using.
criticalProblem.zh: 顧客必須自行解讀商品、通路、消費門檻、到期與疊加規則，才能知道優惠券是否適用、是否值得使用。

decisionDirection.en: Expose applicable items, remaining requirements, usage channel and final value before checkout.
decisionDirection.zh: 在結帳前呈現適用品項、尚差條件、使用通路與最終優惠價值。

summary.en: Grouped product-related value and made qualification guidance visible in the product context.
summary.zh: 在商品情境集中呈現相關優惠，並讓達標引導更容易看見。

label.zh: 可直接購物的優惠券詳情

summary.en: Connected Voucher conditions to eligible products, channel-specific actions and direct Add to Cart.
summary.zh: 將優惠券條件串接至適用品項、通路對應操作與直接加入購物車。

label.zh: 優惠券資訊與狀態模型

summary.en: Defined reusable information priorities, labels, conditions and states across customer touchpoints.
summary.zh: 定義跨顧客接觸點可重用的資訊優先順序、標籤、條件與狀態。

title.en: Match each incentive mechanic to the right participation action
title.zh: 讓每種獎勵機制使用合適的參與操作

criticalProblem.en: Save, Collect, Claim and participation were treated too similarly even though they represented different levels of intent, effort and commitment.
criticalProblem.zh: 儲存、收集、領取與參與常被視為相同操作，但其實代表不同程度的意圖、投入與承諾。

decisionDirection.en: Use mechanic-specific actions, progress and reminders so customers understand what they joined and what remains.
decisionDirection.zh: 依獎勵機制設計操作、進度與提醒，讓顧客理解已參與什麼、還需完成什麼。

summary.en: Scaled an annual campaign from limited app coupons to a repeatable omnichannel saving and redemption journey.
summary.zh: 將年度活動從有限 App 優惠券擴展為可重複運作的全通路儲存與兌換旅程。

summary.en: A featured cross-journey initiative covering acceptance, participation, progress, completion and reward.
summary.zh: 橫跨接受、參與、進度、完成與獎勵的代表性跨旅程計畫。

summary.en: A shipped campaign-scoped pilot that tested time-bound rewards and repeat-order progression before broader platform investment.
summary.zh: 正式上線的活動型前導驗證，在投入更完整平台前測試限時獎勵與重複下單進程。

linkedInitiatives.contentBoundary: The full case remains in Voucher Center Product Evolution; this stage shows only a linked reference.

title.en: Make application states explicit and failures recoverable
title.zh: 讓套用狀態清楚，錯誤可以復原

criticalProblem.en: Added, selected and applied states were easy to confuse, while eligibility, payment and stackability conflicts often surfaced without an actionable recovery path.
criticalProblem.zh: 已加入、已選取與已套用容易混淆；資格、付款與疊加衝突發生時，也常缺少可執行的復原方式。

decisionDirection.en: Separate application states, match Vouchers to cart and channel context, and explain the next recoverable action.
decisionDirection.zh: 區分套用狀態，依購物車與通路情境匹配優惠券，並說明下一個可復原操作。

label.zh: 情境式優惠券錯誤復原

summary.en: Classified failures by cause and next action, then shipped reliable recovery for mapped payment conflicts.
summary.zh: 依原因與下一步分類錯誤，並針對可可靠判斷的付款衝突上線復原流程。

label.zh: 具資格判斷的購物車操作

summary.en: Mapped Voucher condition types and shopping channels to the appropriate product action and guidance.
summary.zh: 依優惠券條件類型與購物通路，對應合適的商品操作與指引。

summary.en: Connected saved campaign Vouchers to Online Grocery, Scan & Go and FairPrice Pay redemption.
summary.zh: 將已儲存的活動優惠券串接至線上購物、Scan & Go 與 FairPrice Pay 兌換。

zh: 已加入、已選取與已套用狀態

title.en: Confirm savings, reward outcomes and what happens next
title.zh: 說清楚節省結果、獎勵去向與下一步

criticalProblem.en: After payment or campaign completion, customers could be unsure what was used, saved, returned or issued for future use.
criticalProblem.zh: 付款或活動完成後，顧客可能不清楚哪些優惠已使用、已節省、已退回，或已發放供後續使用。

decisionDirection.en: Preserve visible savings, usage history, returned-value states and the next reason to participate.
decisionDirection.zh: 保留可見的節省結果、使用紀錄、價值退回狀態，以及再次參與的理由。

summary.en: Connected completion, reward issuance and future participation within one cross-journey initiative.
summary.zh: 在同一跨旅程計畫中串接完成、獎勵發放與未來參與。

summary.en: Provided campaign-level evidence of digital redemption and repeatable annual operation.
summary.zh: 提供數位兌換與年度活動可重複運作的計畫層級證據。

zh: 已使用、已過期與已退回狀態

evidenceBoundary.en: This stage has fewer standalone deep dives. It groups confirmed cross-journey evidence without inventing a separate case.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此階段較少獨立深度案例，因此只整合已確認的跨旅程證據，不另行虛構子專案。

title.en: Voucher Wallet
title.zh: 優惠券錢包

summary.en: Voucher Wallet supports discovery, qualification, activation, redemption and history across the five-stage journey; it is not a standalone project or one journey stage.
summary.zh: 優惠券錢包橫跨五階段旅程，支援探索、資格判斷、啟動、兌換與紀錄；它不是獨立專案，也不是單一旅程階段。

title.en: Prioritise observed discovery behaviour over requested Search
title.zh: 依實際探索行為排序，而非優先開發搜尋

whatIDecided.en: Recommended prioritising Tabs, Filters, contextual entry and relevance grouping before universal Voucher Wallet Search.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議先強化分頁、篩選、情境式入口與相關性分組，再評估通用優惠券錢包搜尋。

whyThisChoice.en: During real tasks, 0/9 participants used Search even though 5/9 later rated it as important when prompted. Customers mainly scrolled, explored categories or began from products.
whyThisChoice.zh: 真實任務中 0/9 位參與者使用搜尋，雖然事後被詢問時有 5/9 認為搜尋重要；顧客主要透過捲動、分類探索，或從商品開始。

content.en: Accepted less support for rare exact-item lookup in exchange for a simpler Wallet centred on dominant exploratory behaviour.
content.zh: 接受較少支援少見的精準查找，以換取更符合主要探索行為的簡化錢包。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Less support for rare exact-item lookup
tradeOff.protectedValue: Product focus and lower interaction complexity
tradeOff.constraint: No observed Search use during customer tasks

ownership.en: Led evidence synthesis and the product recommendation; prioritisation was aligned with Product and Research.
ownership.zh: 主導證據統整與產品建議，並與產品及研究團隊對齊優先順序。

strategy.en: Use one system-level Hero, one distinct visual per journey stage and one distinct visual per programme decision. Reuse a physical asset by Asset ID only when the same evidence is intentionally referenced; do not display it twice in the primary narrative.
strategy.zh: 使用一張系統層級主視覺、每個旅程階段一張不同視覺，以及每項計畫決策一張不同視覺。同一實體素材僅在刻意引用相同證據時共用 Asset ID，主要敘事中不得重複顯示。

purpose.en: Explain the five-stage journey and shared incentive foundation within five seconds.
purpose.zh: 在五秒內說明五階段旅程與共享獎勵基礎。

caption.en: Relevant Voucher value moved from Wallet-dependent discovery into product and shopping contexts.
caption.zh: 相關優惠價值從依賴錢包探索，移入商品與購物情境。

caption.en: Voucher conditions mapped to eligible products, channel context and the next useful action.
caption.zh: 優惠券條件對應至適用品項、通路情境與下一個有效操作。

caption.en: Campaign participation connected discovery, saving, progress and cross-channel redemption.
caption.zh: 活動參與串接探索、儲存、進度與跨通路兌換。

caption.en: Failure causes were translated into explicit application states and recoverable next actions.
caption.zh: 錯誤原因被轉化為明確套用狀態與可復原的下一步。

caption.en: Post-use communication confirms redeemed value, returned rewards and the next participation opportunity.
caption.zh: 使用後溝通確認已兌換價值、回流獎勵與下一次參與機會。

boundary.en: Use only public-safe confirmation and campaign-result evidence; do not expose raw dashboards.
boundary.zh: 只使用可公開的結果確認與活動成果證據，不得曝光原始儀表板。

caption.en: One system view showing how contextual value connects product discovery, qualification and action.
caption.zh: 以一張系統圖呈現情境價值如何串接商品探索、資格判斷與操作。

caption.en: The ideal end state was sequenced into foundations, intent capture, effort reduction and later automation.
caption.zh: 理想終態被拆成基礎、意圖取得、降低負擔與後續自動化。

caption.en: Voucher type selection in Operations setup mapped to the correct shared card treatment.
caption.zh: 營運設定中的優惠券類型選擇會對應至正確的共享卡片呈現。

caption.en: Observed task behaviour contrasted with stated Search preference, redirecting priority to Tabs, Filters and contextual entry.
caption.zh: 真實任務行為與口述搜尋偏好形成對比，使優先順序轉向分頁、篩選與情境式入口。

summary.en: Led the evidence, journey and system framing that connected multiple Voucher initiatives; programme mechanics, phasing and business priorities were decided with cross-functional partners.
summary.zh: 主導串接多個優惠券計畫的證據、旅程與系統定義；計畫機制、分階段策略與商業優先順序則由跨職能夥伴共同決定。

en: Cross-initiative evidence synthesis and five-stage journey framing
Customer interaction, state and recovery design for owned initiatives
Reusable Voucher Card and component-system modelling
zh: 跨計畫證據統整與五階段旅程定義
主責計畫的顧客互動、狀態與復原設計
可重用優惠券卡片與元件系統建模

en: Reward mechanics, programme phasing and investment priorities
Formal Design System adoption and governance
zh: 獎勵機制、計畫分階段與投資優先順序
正式設計系統採用與治理
研究招募與專業研究引導
工程實作與正式環境交付

en: Five-stage Voucher journey and shared Voucher structure
Shipped and partially shipped discovery, eligibility, activation and recovery initiatives
Implemented shared Voucher Card and Operations mapping
zh: 五階段優惠券旅程與共享優惠券結構
已上線或部分上線的探索、資格、啟動與復原計畫
已實作的共享優惠券卡片與營運對應

en: Customer task behaviour across Wallet, product and checkout studies
Live campaign, adoption and operational evidence
zh: 錢包、商品與結帳研究中的顧客任務行為
正式活動、產品採用與營運證據

summary.en: Measurement combined research behaviour, campaign snapshots and shipped-product adoption. Headline internal metrics remain rounded or qualitative.
summary.zh: 衡量結合研究行為、活動資料與已上線產品採用情況；重要內部數據僅以約略值或質化方式公開。

en: Shared component and Operations mapping implemented
Programme evidence and system direction delivered
zh: 多項顧客端優惠券計畫已上線
共享元件與營運對應已實作
計畫證據與系統方向已交付

en: Causal attribution of programme-wide business outcomes to design alone
zh: 部分後續條件驅動版本
將整體商業成果單獨歸因於設計

label.zh: 已驗證・數據經抽象處理

confidentialityNote.en: For confidentiality reasons, exact internal metrics are not disclosed.
confidentialityNote.zh: 基於保密考量，不公開精確內部數據。

voucher-center.transformation_zh: 集中優惠券探索與領取
voucher-center.summary: A permanent Voucher Center replaced fragmented campaign destinations and passive auto-deposit with an active discovery, claim and Checkout model.
voucher-center.summary_zh: 以常設 Voucher Center 取代分散的活動入口與被動存入方式，建立主動探索、領取與結帳套用流程。
voucher-center.owned: Research direction · Prototype design · Wallet and Checkout flows · Retrospective · Phase planning
voucher-center.owned_zh: 研究方向・原型設計・錢包與結帳流程・回顧統整・分階段規劃
voucher-center.at_glance: Led end-to-end design of a permanent Voucher Center spanning discovery, claiming, eligibility and Checkout application across online grocery, in-store payment, Kopitiam and Partner Voucher journeys.
voucher-center.at_glance_zh: 主導常設 Voucher Center 的端到端設計，涵蓋線上購物、店內付款、Kopitiam 與合作夥伴優惠券旅程中的探索、領取、資格判斷與結帳套用。
voucher-center.scope: End-to-end Voucher discovery, claiming, eligibility and Checkout application across online grocery, in-store App payment, Kopitiam and Partner Voucher journeys.
voucher-center.scope_zh: 涵蓋線上購物、店內 App 付款、Kopitiam 與合作夥伴優惠券旅程的探索、領取、資格判斷與結帳套用。
voucher-center.audience: Primary: FairPrice customers discovering, claiming and applying Vouchers
voucher-center.audience_zh: 主要：探索、領取與套用優惠券的 FairPrice 顧客
voucher-center.why: Customers could not reliably find or understand available Vouchers before shopping because campaign entry points, Wallet discovery and Checkout application were fragmented.
voucher-center.why_zh: 活動入口、錢包探索與結帳套用彼此分散，使顧客在購物前無法可靠找到並理解可用優惠券。
voucher-center.impact: Created a permanent product surface and shared state model that allowed new Voucher campaigns to reuse existing discovery, claiming, eligibility and application behaviour.
voucher-center.impact_zh: 建立常設產品介面與共享狀態模型，讓新的優惠券活動能重用既有的探索、領取、資格判斷與套用行為。

productEvolutionImplementationContract.implementationRule: Audit the existing reusable Evidence/Journey components first. Extend the actual owner with a safe variant; do not duplicate the Project Detail shell, page, CSS owner, or media viewer.

title.en: Customers needed one mental model, but not one interaction everywhere
title.zh: 顧客需要一致的心智模型，但不同情境不能使用完全相同的互動

goal.zh: 理解價值、瀏覽並縮小範圍

patterns: Visible count of Vouchers available to claim
Claim by default and View after claiming
Tabs, contextual filters and relevant grouping

goal.zh: 完成付款且不漏用優惠

label.zh: 誤解立即使用會自動套用

label.en: said they would claim all; Claim all was not shipped
label.zh: 表示會領取全部；全部領取最終未上線

observedVsStated.en: Stated preference repeatedly differed from observed behaviour: Search was rated important but unused, while customers repeatedly tapped visible Claim entry points and expected action labels to describe the real system outcome.
observedVsStated.zh: 口述偏好與觀察行為多次出現差異：搜尋被評為重要卻未被使用；顧客則會反覆點擊清楚可見的領取入口，並期待操作標籤能準確說明真正的系統結果。

decisions.title: From one Voucher list to task-specific discovery and application
decisions.title_zh: 從單一優惠券列表，到依任務設計的探索與套用
decisions.whatIDecided: Separated Voucher interaction by customer intent: exploratory grouping and filtering for discovery, explicit eligibility and Select all for Checkout completion.
decisions.whatIDecided_zh: 依顧客意圖拆分優惠券互動：探索情境使用分組與篩選，結帳則使用明確資格判斷與全選來完成付款。
decisions.whyThisChoice: Wallet participants explored broadly and narrowed by context, while Checkout participants wanted to apply savings without evaluating every Voucher independently.
decisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 錢包參與者會廣泛探索並依情境縮小範圍；結帳參與者則希望不必逐張判斷優惠券，就能套用優惠完成付款。
decisions.evidence: Across the foundation study, 8 of 9 used Tabs, 7 of 9 used Filters and Checkout ease averaged ~4.7/5.

decisions.title: From requested Search to evidence-led exploration
decisions.title_zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索
decisions.whatIDecided: Recommended not prioritising universal Wallet Search and invested first in Tabs, Filters, contextual entry and relevance grouping.
decisions.whatIDecided_zh: 建議不優先開發通用錢包搜尋，先投入分頁、篩選、情境式入口與依相關性分組。
decisions.whyThisChoice: None of the 9 participants used Search during real tasks, although 5 later rated it important when prompted. Observed behaviour showed customers mainly scrolled, explored categories and started from products.
decisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 9 位參與者在真實任務中無人使用搜尋，但被詢問時有 5 位將其評為重要。觀察行為顯示，顧客主要透過捲動、分類探索，或從商品開始。

content.en: Accepted less support for rare exact-item lookup in exchange for a simpler Wallet centred on the dominant exploratory behaviour.
content.zh: 接受較少支援少見的精準品項搜尋，換取以主要探索行為為核心、更簡單的優惠券錢包。

optionalBlock.content_zh: 接受較少支援少數精準查找情境，以換取更貼近主要探索行為的簡化錢包。

tradeOff.chosen: Exploration patterns supported by observed behaviour
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Less support for rare exact-item lookup
tradeOff.protectedValue: Product focus and lower interaction complexity
tradeOff.constraint: No observed Search use during customer tasks

decisions.migrationReason: This decision concerns Voucher Wallet behaviour, not the Voucher Center product.

decisions.title: From full consolidation to a focused first release
decisions.title_zh: 從完整整合方向，到聚焦的第一階段上線
decisions.whatIDecided: Shipped a permanent homepage Voucher Center entry with the number of claimable Vouchers, replaced the purple visual language with a red/green hierarchy, and defined Claim → View card states. Claim all remained out of scope while the broader consolidated architecture stayed as the target direction.
decisions.whatIDecided_zh: 上線永久性的首頁 Voucher Center 入口與可領取優惠券數量，將紫色視覺語言改為紅色／綠色層級，並定義領取 → 查看的卡片狀態。全部領取未納入上線範圍，較完整的整合架構則保留為目標方向。
decisions.whyThisChoice: The entry and count addressed discovery, while state-specific actions clarified what happened after claiming. Retail Media placement and Engineering delivery constraints required a narrower first release than the research-preferred consolidated model.
decisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 入口與數量解決探索；依狀態變化的操作則清楚說明領取後結果。零售媒體版位與工程團隊交付限制，使第一階段必須比研究偏好的整合模型更聚焦。

content.en: Accepted a narrower Phase 1 than the research-preferred consolidated model in exchange for protecting commercial placement and meeting the Engineering delivery window.
content.zh: 接受第一階段範圍小於研究偏好的整合模型，換取保留商業版位並符合工程交付時程。

optionalBlock.content_zh: 接受比研究偏好整合模型更精簡的階段 1，以換取保留商業版位並符合工程團隊交付時程。

tradeOff.chosen: A focused first release with a permanent entry, claimable count and explicit card states
tradeOff.notChosen: The complete research-preferred consolidated architecture at launch
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Some navigation and claiming efficiency remained unresolved in the first release
tradeOff.constraint: Retail Media placement and Engineering timeline

shippedOutcome: Count of Vouchers available to claim

clarifications: The homepage Voucher Center entry and claimable count are confirmed shipped.
The production Voucher Card action is Claim by default and View after claiming.
The purple Voucher Center visual direction was replaced by red/green in production.
Shipped Kopitiam and Voucher-type Tabs are not proof that the proposed top-level Your vouchers / Claim more tab architecture shipped.
The exact final one-page versus separate-page production architecture still requires confirmation.
Home-swimlane Claim buttons shown in research prototypes are not confirmed shipped.
confirmed: Homepage Voucher Center entry
Number of Vouchers available to claim shown at the entry
Red/green Voucher Center colour system replacing purple
Claimable Voucher Card state: Claim by default → View after claimed
Kopitiam Tab
Applicable / Not applicable
Select all in Checkout
Voucher-type filter
Partner Voucher integration
Shared Voucher Card reuse
notShipped: Future Claim → Shop → Apply state-aware model

relationshipToVision.en: Voucher Center was a separately shipped customer product that realised part of the broader Voucher / Offer vision through clearer discovery, eligibility and application states.
relationshipToVision.zh: Voucher Center 是獨立上線的顧客產品，透過更清楚的探索、資格與套用狀態，實現整體優惠券與優惠願景的部分方向。

cta.en: View the broader Voucher / Offer Vision
cta.zh: 查看更完整的優惠券／優惠願景

saveAll.en: Campaign-page action that saves all campaign Vouchers into the Wallet.
saveAll.zh: 在活動頁一次將所有活動優惠券儲存至錢包的操作。

selectAll.en: Checkout action that selects all applicable saved Vouchers.
selectAll.zh: 在結帳一次選取所有適用且已儲存優惠券的操作。

rule.en: Save all performance must not be presented as Select all outcome evidence.
rule.zh: 全部儲存的成效不得被呈現為全選的結果證據。

eyebrow.zh: 產品演進・已上線活動型前導

title.en: From a focused campaign journey to reusable Voucher behaviours
title.zh: 從聚焦型活動旅程，到可重用的優惠券行為模型

summary.en: Research first defined context-specific access. A later Flash Voucher campaign shipped a focused implementation of discovery, saving, shopping and a four-order reward progression before selected behaviours were generalised in Voucher Center.
summary.zh: 研究先定義符合情境的優惠券存取模式；後續 Flash Voucher 活動正式上線探索、儲存、購物與四次下單獎勵進程，再將部分行為一般化至 Voucher Center。

visualEvidenceRules: Use cropped real product screens, not the full source flow board.
Keep product UI readable at project-detail width.
Use concise captions under each screen.
Do not use Flash Voucher as the sole Voucher Center hero image.
Redact personal data, internal comments and implementation notes.
Do not fabricate missing production screens.

eyebrow.en: SHIPPED POC · PRODUCT AND BUSINESS EVOLUTION
eyebrow.zh: 已上線前導驗證・產品與商業演進

title.en: Validate repeat-order behaviour before investing in a full Flash Deal platform
title.zh: 先驗證重複下單行為，再投入完整限時優惠平台

atAGlance.en: Led the product design of a campaign-scoped Flash Voucher journey for segmented acquisition and repeat-order customers, using targeted entry, limited-time collection, direct shopping paths and return rewards to support progression towards four orders.
atAGlance.zh: 主導活動型 Flash Voucher 產品設計，依新客取得與重複下單客群提供分眾入口、限時領取、直接購物路徑與回流獎勵，支援顧客推進至四次下單。

title.en: What became reusable
title.zh: 哪些能力被轉化為可重用基礎

items.zh: 依情境設計入口與探索方式
儲存至錢包的行為模型
清楚呈現可用性與適用資格狀態
支援跨使用階段返回獎勵旅程

contentBoundary.en: Present this as selected behaviours generalised across product work—not as proof that every Flash Voucher screen directly became Voucher Center.
contentBoundary.zh: 應呈現為部分行為在後續產品中被一般化，不得宣稱每個 Flash Voucher 畫面都直接變成 Voucher Center。

cta.en: View the broader Voucher / Offer Vision
cta.zh: 查看完整優惠券／優惠願景

continueExploring.independentProjectRule: Voucher Center remains an independent project card and route.

title.en: From requested Search to evidence-led exploration
title.zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索

proof.en: 0/9 used or mentioned Search in real tasks; 5/9 still rated it as important when prompted.
proof.zh: 真實任務中 0/9 使用或提及搜尋；但被提示後仍有 5/9 認為它重要。

executiveSummary.problem: One growing Wallet was being asked to support both broad exploration and time-sensitive payment decisions.
executiveSummary.strategy: Separate discovery from application, then standardise the states and controls each context required.
executiveSummary.outcome: Shipped Tabs, applicability states, Select all, Voucher-type filtering, Partner Voucher integration and shared Voucher Card reuse.

title.en: The product model evolved through research, constraint and funnel evidence
title.zh: 產品模型透過研究、限制與漏斗證據持續演進

sample.zh: 18 位參與者・錢包與結帳各 9 位

focus.en: Separate exploratory discovery from time-sensitive application.
focus.zh: 區分探索式瀏覽與時間敏感的套用任務。

result.zh: 依任務設計的錢包與結帳模式。

label.zh: 產品架構 A/B 測試

sample.zh: 20 位參與者・2 組交叉平衡測試・6 小時 18 分鐘錄影

focus.en: Test entry visibility, one-page versus two-page architecture and action semantics.
focus.zh: 測試入口可見性、單頁／雙頁架構與操作語意。

evidence: 12 preferred the bold Voucher Center entry
8 completed the savings task on first try with the entry versus 6 without it
7 preferred the one-page tab model versus 4 for separate pages

problem.zh: SEC 與限時分別建立活動頁面，使顧客探索可用優惠券的入口變得分散。

coreInsight.zh: 優惠券探索與優惠券套用需要不同互動模式。

description.zh: 在專屬 Flash Voucher 頁面完成儲存、查看可用狀態並直接開始購物。

claimBoundary: Always label these as proposal targets or modelled business case.

title.en: Sequence Flash Voucher before supplier-funded product deals
title.zh: 先上線 Flash Voucher，再推進供應商出資商品優惠

whatIDecided.en: Split the Flash journey into two phases. Phase 1 used targeted, cart-level Flash Vouchers with limited-time collection, direct shopping paths and return Vouchers for progression towards four orders. Supplier-funded Flash Product Deals were deferred to Phase 2.
whatIDecided.zh: 將限時優惠旅程拆成兩個階段。第一階段採用分眾、購物車層級的 Flash Voucher，包含限時領取、直接購物路徑，以及推進至四次下單的回流優惠券；供應商出資的 Flash Product Deals 延後至第二階段。

whyThisChoice.en: The POC had a short delivery window. Product-level deals required additional work on SKU planning, pricing, quantity and redemption controls, personalised surfacing and several cross-team technology dependencies.
whyThisChoice.zh: 前導驗證的交付時程短；商品層級優惠還需要額外處理商品規劃、定價、數量與兌換控管、個人化呈現，以及多個團隊之間的技術依賴。

content.en: Phase 1 intentionally tested the lower-dependency Voucher mechanic first. It could test targeted entry, urgency, collection, direct shopping and repeat-order progression, but it did not test supplier-funded SKU economics, product-level quantity controls or monetisation.
content.zh: 第一階段刻意先測試依賴較低的優惠券機制，可驗證分眾入口、急迫感、領取、直接購物與重複下單進程；但無法驗證供應商出資的商品經濟模型、商品層級數量控管或變現模式。

phase1.zh: 分眾、購物車層級的 Flash Voucher 前導驗證

phase2Deferred.zh: 供應商出資的 Flash Product Deals

reasonForDeferral.en: Short POC timeline, technology limitations and additional SKU and pricing planning.
reasonForDeferral.zh: 前導驗證時程短、技術限制，以及仍需補足商品與定價規劃。

en: Return Vouchers supporting progression towards four orders

hiringSignal.zh: 呈現分階段判斷力：先交付依賴較低、可測試的機制，再將高複雜度商品優惠能力留到後續階段。

sourceBoundary.en: The source supports a two-phase plan and explicit deferral. It does not support describing Phase 2 as rejected or proving that Phase 1 achieved the target behavioural outcomes.
sourceBoundary.zh: 來源支持兩階段規劃與明確延後，但不支持將第二階段描述為被否決，也不能證明第一階段已達成目標行為成果。

opportunities: Premium supplier listings and featured deal placements

title.en: From requested Search to evidence-led exploration
title.zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索

whatIDecided.en: Recommended not shipping Search in the Voucher Wallet and prioritised Tabs, Filters and contextual entry points that better matched how customers actually explored Vouchers.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議不在優惠券錢包上線搜尋，改為優先發展更符合顧客實際探索行為的分頁、篩選與情境式入口。

whyThisChoice.en: During browsing and voucher-location tasks, none of the 9 participants mentioned or attempted to use Search. Yet 5 of 9 later ranked Search as important when asked directly. This showed that stated preference did not match observed behaviour: customers mainly scrolled, explored categories and started from products rather than entering the Wallet with a precise search target.
whyThisChoice.zh: 在瀏覽與尋找優惠券的任務中，9 位參與者都沒有主動提及或嘗試使用搜尋；但被直接詢問功能重要性時，9 位中有 5 位又將搜尋列為重要。這顯示口述偏好與實際行為不一致：顧客主要透過捲動、分類探索，或從商品開始，而不是帶著精準關鍵字進入錢包。

content.en: We chose not to add a familiar Search control, accepting less support for rare goal-directed lookup in exchange for a simpler Wallet focused on the dominant exploratory behaviour.
content.zh: 我們選擇不加入熟悉的搜尋控制，接受較少支援少數明確目標式查找情境，以換取更貼近主要探索行為的簡化錢包。

patterns: Users primarily scrolled rather than searched.
Users tended to scroll about 5–6 times and return to the top.
Tabs and Filters encouraged exploration without a specific goal.
Product category and usage channel helped locate relevant Vouchers.
Specific-product journeys often started from the product or PDP.

walletSearch.principalSignal: Used observed behaviour to challenge stated preference and a Business-requested feature, protected product focus, and redirected investment toward higher-evidence discovery patterns.

title.en: Centralising voucher discovery and claiming
title.zh: 集中優惠券探索與領取

atAGlance.en: Led end-to-end design of a permanent Voucher Center spanning discovery, claiming, eligibility and Checkout application across online grocery, in-store payment, Kopitiam and Partner Voucher journeys.
atAGlance.zh: 主導常設 Voucher Center 的端到端設計，涵蓋線上購物、店內付款、Kopitiam 與合作夥伴優惠券旅程中的探索、領取、資格判斷與結帳套用。

whyItMattered.en: Customers could not reliably find or understand available Vouchers before shopping because campaign entry points, Wallet discovery and Checkout application were fragmented.
whyItMattered.zh: 活動入口、錢包探索與結帳套用彼此分散，使顧客在購物前無法可靠找到並理解可用優惠券。

businessImpact.en: Created a permanent product surface and shared state model that allowed new Voucher campaigns to reuse existing discovery, claiming, eligibility and application behaviour.
businessImpact.zh: 建立常設產品介面與共享狀態模型，讓新的優惠券活動能重用既有的探索、領取、資格判斷與套用行為。

scope.en: End-to-end Voucher discovery, claiming, eligibility and Checkout application across online grocery, in-store App payment, Kopitiam and Partner Voucher journeys.
scope.zh: 涵蓋線上購物、店內 App 付款、Kopitiam 與合作夥伴優惠券旅程的探索、領取、資格判斷與結帳套用。

audience.en: Primary: FairPrice customers discovering, claiming and applying Vouchers
audience.zh: 主要：探索、領取與套用優惠券的 FairPrice 顧客

headline.en: Across two research phases with 38 participants, I translated observed behaviour into a permanent entry, claimable count, Claim → View states and Checkout Select all.
headline.zh: 透過兩階段、共 38 位參與者的研究，我將觀察行為轉化為常設入口、可領取數量、領取 → 查看狀態與結帳全選。

supportingStatement.en: I also recommended against universal Wallet Search after 0/9 participants used it during real tasks, redirecting effort towards Tabs, Filters and contextual entry points.
supportingStatement.zh: 真實任務中 0/9 位參與者使用搜尋後，我也建議不優先開發通用錢包搜尋，將資源轉向分頁、篩選與情境式入口。

publicLine.en: Primary Product Designer · Product structure, research synthesis and interaction design
publicLine.zh: 主要產品設計師・產品架構、研究統整與互動設計

ledScope.en: Product structure, research synthesis and interaction design
ledScope.zh: 產品架構、研究統整與互動設計

sharedBoundary.en: Launch scope and roadmap decisions were shared with Product, Engineering and Business.
sharedBoundary.zh: 上線範圍與產品路線由產品、工程及商務共同決定。

scope.en: End-to-end Voucher discovery, claiming, eligibility and Checkout application across online grocery, in-store App payment, Kopitiam and Partner Voucher journeys.
scope.zh: 涵蓋線上購物、店內 App 付款、Kopitiam 與合作夥伴優惠券旅程的探索、領取、資格判斷與結帳套用。

audience.en: Primary: FairPrice customers discovering, claiming and applying Vouchers
audience.zh: 主要：探索、領取與套用優惠券的 FairPrice 顧客

criticalProblem.en: Customers could not reliably find or understand available Vouchers before shopping because campaign entry points, Wallet discovery and Checkout application were fragmented.
criticalProblem.zh: 活動入口、錢包探索與結帳套用彼此分散，使顧客在購物前無法可靠找到並理解可用優惠券。

primary.en: FairPrice customers discovering, claiming and applying Vouchers
primary.zh: 探索、領取與套用優惠券的 FairPrice 顧客

publicRoleLine.en: Primary Product Designer · Led product structure, research synthesis and interaction design; launch scope was shared.
publicRoleLine.zh: 主要產品設計師・主導產品架構、研究統整與互動設計；上線範圍由團隊共同決定。

voucher-center.scaleEvidenceRule: Show only evidence that materially improves hiring evaluation; do not fill a fixed card count.

ledScope.en: Product structure, research synthesis and interaction design
ledScope.zh: 產品架構、研究統整與互動設計

sharedBoundary.en: Launch scope and roadmap decisions were shared with Product, Engineering and Business.
sharedBoundary.zh: 上線範圍與產品路線由產品、工程及商務共同決定。

displayLine.en: Primary Product Designer · Product structure, research synthesis and interaction design
displayLine.zh: 主要產品設計師・產品架構、研究統整與互動設計

scaleDisplay.renderRule: Render only launch breadth, active usage breadth, organisational deployment or materially differentiating system coverage.
excludedEvidence: Device count unless it proves materially different product coverage

evidenceSummary.en: In the foundation study, 8/9 used Tabs and 7/9 used Filters, while Checkout ease averaged ~4.7/5; task-specific Wallet and Checkout behaviours later informed shipped capabilities.
evidenceSummary.zh: 基礎研究中，8/9 使用分頁、7/9 使用篩選，結帳容易度平均約 4.7/5；依任務區分的錢包與結帳行為後續推動部分能力上線。

title.en: From one Voucher list to task-specific discovery and application
title.zh: 從單一優惠券列表，到依任務設計的探索與套用

evidenceSummary.en: The permanent entry, claimable count, red/green hierarchy and Claim → View states shipped; Claim all and the full consolidated architecture did not.
evidenceSummary.zh: 常設入口、可領取數量、紅綠層級與領取 → 查看狀態已上線；全部領取與完整整合架構未上線。

title.en: From full consolidation to a focused first release
title.zh: 從完整整合方向，到聚焦的第一階段上線

reason.en: Precursor and product-evolution evidence; retained inside the Flash Voucher disclosure.
reason.zh: 屬於前導與產品演進證據，保留於 Flash Voucher 佐證資料中。

decisionNarrative.primaryRenderRule: Resolve each sourcePath and render the source decision in this order. Do not duplicate or rewrite the source decision in the component.
decisionNarrative.supportingRenderRule: Supporting decisions are hidden from the primary page flow and appear only in the existing supporting-evidence disclosure.

mappingCorrection.en: The universal Search decision was moved to the cross-journey Voucher Wallet under Voucher / Offer Vision.
mappingCorrection.zh: 通用搜尋決策已移至優惠券／優惠願景下的跨旅程優惠券錢包。

caption.en: Two-phase plan: targeted Flash Vouchers first, supplier-funded Flash Product Deals later.
caption.zh: 兩階段規劃：先上線分眾 Flash Voucher，後續再推進供應商出資商品優惠。

strategicValidationPath.rule: Use real product evidence for both phases. Do not generate a decorative infographic that replaces the product screens.

eyebrow.zh: 前導驗證 → 證據 → 產品基礎

title.en: From a shipped pilot to a sponsor-ready Voucher destination
title.zh: 從已上線前導驗證，到可承接贊助優惠券的產品入口

intro.en: Voucher Center depended on a credible supply of sponsor-funded Vouchers. Sponsors needed evidence that a new digital mechanic could attract participation and move customers towards purchase before committing funding, so Flash Voucher was launched first as an in-market pilot.
intro.zh: Voucher Center 很依賴贊助單位出資的優惠券。贊助單位在投入前，需要看到新的數位機制能吸引參與並推動顧客走向購買，因此先以 Flash Voucher 作為市場中的前導驗證。

strategyStatement.en: Use a smaller shipped mechanic to reduce sponsor uncertainty, then generalise the validated behaviours into a persistent Voucher product.
strategyStatement.zh: 先用較小、已上線的機制降低贊助單位的不確定性，再將已驗證的行為一般化為持續型優惠券產品。

label.zh: 第一階段・已上線前導驗證

title.en: Flash Voucher
title.zh: Flash Voucher

businessQuestion.en: Could a targeted, time-bound Voucher mechanic create enough participation and purchase intent to support a larger sponsor proposition?
businessQuestion.zh: 分眾、限時的優惠券機制，是否能產生足以支撐更大型贊助提案的參與與購買意圖？

en: Return Vouchers supporting progression towards four orders
zh: 以回流優惠券支援推進至四次下單

evidenceRole.en: Created an in-market proof point for sponsor conversations and tested selected Voucher behaviours before building a persistent product surface.
evidenceRole.zh: 在建立持續型產品介面前，先測試部分優惠券行為，並形成可用於贊助單位溝通的市場證據。

alt.en: Flash Voucher pilot flow showing targeted entry, limited-time collection, shopping and reward progression.
alt.zh: Flash Voucher 前導流程，呈現分眾入口、限時領取、購物與獎勵進程。

doNotCrop.en: Keep the campaign entry, Save or Claim action, direct-shopping path and reward progression readable.
doNotCrop.zh: 不得裁掉活動入口、儲存或領取操作、直接購物路徑與獎勵進程。

label.zh: 第二階段・已上線產品基礎

title.en: Voucher Center
title.zh: Voucher Center

businessQuestion.en: How could the product turn campaign evidence into a persistent destination that sponsors could fund and customers could repeatedly discover, claim and use?
businessQuestion.zh: 產品如何將活動證據轉化為持續型入口，讓贊助單位願意出資，也讓顧客能反覆探索、領取與使用？

en: Reusable discovery, eligibility and application behaviours
zh: 可領取數量與分類入口
可重用的探索、資格判斷與套用行為

sponsorValue.en: Provided a more durable product surface for sponsor-funded Vouchers than one-off campaign destinations, while keeping creation and campaign setup with Operations.
sponsorValue.zh: 相較一次性活動入口，提供更持久的產品介面承接贊助單位出資的優惠券；優惠券與活動建立仍由營運團隊負責。

alt.en: Voucher Center product showing a permanent destination for Voucher discovery and claiming.
alt.zh: Voucher Center 產品畫面，呈現常設的優惠券探索與領取入口。

doNotCrop.en: Keep the permanent entry, claimable count, category access and Claim or View state readable.
doNotCrop.zh: 不得裁掉常設入口、可領取數量、分類入口與領取或查看狀態。

label.zh: 用於贊助單位溝通的市場證據

headline.en: Shipped behaviour evidence reduced the uncertainty of asking sponsors to fund an unproven product.
headline.zh: 已上線的行為證據，降低了要求贊助單位投入未經驗證產品的不確定性。

en: A real campaign journey rather than a concept-only proposal
Reusable behaviours that could carry into a permanent product
zh: 可觀察的參與與購物行為
真實活動旅程，而非只有概念提案
可延伸至持續型產品的重用行為

metricDisplayRule.en: Do not display a conversion rate until an approved rounded post-launch metric is supplied.
metricDisplayRule.zh: 在取得核准且四捨五入的上線後數據前，不顯示轉化率。

pilot.zh: 活動可用性與兌換狀態

platform.en: Reusable Claim → View and Voucher states
platform.zh: 可重用的領取 → 查看與優惠券狀態
跨使用階段持續保留的價值

relationshipBoundary.en: Flash Voucher did not become Voucher Center unchanged. It supplied a shipped behavioural proof point and selected interaction patterns that were later generalised into the persistent product.
relationshipBoundary.zh: Flash Voucher 並非原封不動變成 Voucher Center；它提供已上線的行為證據與部分互動模式，後續再被一般化為持續型產品。

en: Do not claim a specific Flash Voucher conversion rate without an approved rounded metric.
Do not claim that Flash Voucher alone caused sponsor adoption.
Do not claim increased sponsor count, funding or revenue without measured evidence.
Do not imply sponsor self-service shipped; Operations still created Vouchers and campaigns.
Do not state that every Flash Voucher screen became Voucher Center.
zh: 沒有核准且四捨五入的數據前，不得主張特定 Flash Voucher 轉化率。
不得主張 Flash Voucher 單獨造成贊助單位加入。
沒有衡量證據前，不得主張贊助單位數、出資或收入增加。
不得暗示贊助單位自助設定已上線；優惠券與活動仍由營運團隊建立。
不得宣稱每個 Flash Voucher 畫面都直接成為 Voucher Center。

en: Flash Voucher formally shipped as a campaign-scoped journey.
Its business objective was acquisition and progression towards repeated orders.
Selected behaviours later carried into Voucher Center.
No post-launch performance metric was provided in the source.
zh: Flash Voucher 以活動範圍正式上線。
商業目標包含新客取得與推進重複下單。
部分行為後續延伸至 Voucher Center。
來源未提供上線後成效數據。

userConfirmed.en: Sponsors needed credible conversion evidence before funding Vouchers; Flash Voucher was intentionally used as an early in-market proof point for the Voucher Center sponsor proposition.
userConfirmed.zh: 贊助單位在出資優惠券前需要可信的轉化證據；Flash Voucher 被刻意用作 Voucher Center 贊助提案的早期市場證據。

mobile.media: existing swipeable evidence rail when more than one screen is available

motion.en: Use a subtle directional reveal only; reduced motion shows the complete static sequence.
motion.zh: 只使用細微的方向性顯示；降低動態模式直接呈現完整靜態順序。

summary.en: Led the product structure, prototype direction, research synthesis and final interaction model; release scope and roadmap decisions were shared with Product, Engineering, Business and Design System partners.
summary.zh: 主導產品架構、原型方向、研究統整與最終互動模型；上線範圍與產品路線則由產品、工程、商務與設計系統夥伴共同決定。

en: Claim, View, count and status interaction model
zh: 原型設計與可用性測試統整
領取、查看、數量與狀態互動模型

en: Deferral of Claim all and the full consolidated architecture
Flash Voucher to Voucher Center roadmap
zh: 延後全部領取與完整整合架構
Flash Voucher 至 Voucher Center 的演進路線
產品需求文件與商業優先排序
工程可行性與上線規劃

en: Permanent Voucher entry and claimable count
Claim → View card states and red/green status hierarchy
A reusable foundation for discovery, claiming, eligibility and application
zh: 常設優惠券入口與可領取數量
領取 → 查看卡片狀態與紅綠狀態層級
可重用的探索、領取、資格與套用基礎

en: Foundation and Voucher Center usability studies
Observed intent to revisit the permanent Voucher destination
zh: 基礎研究與 Voucher Center 可用性測試
對常設優惠券入口的再次使用意圖

summary.en: Customer intent and interaction behaviour were validated. No approved Flash Voucher conversion rate or sponsor-adoption outcome is available.
summary.zh: 已驗證顧客意圖與互動行為；目前沒有可公開的 Flash Voucher 轉化率或贊助單位採用成果。

en: Permanent entry, count and Claim → View states shipped
Flash Voucher shipped as an earlier pilot
zh: 常設入口、數量與領取 → 查看狀態已上線
第一階段產品基礎已推出
Flash Voucher 已先行作為前導版本上線

label.zh: 已驗證・未衡量贊助成果

purpose.en: Let a hiring manager understand the product problem, phased sponsor validation, research logic, product decisions, shipped scope and ownership without reading duplicated case-study sections.
purpose.zh: 讓招聘者不用閱讀重複案例段落，就能理解產品問題、贊助驗證路徑、研究邏輯、產品決策、上線範圍與主導責任。

sectionNavigator.stickyOffsetRule: Use the existing Popup header and navigator offset token. Do not hardcode per-section scroll offsets.
sectionNavigator.mobileRule: Use the existing horizontal Navigator rail with no mask, no clipped item and no inactive arrow controls.

renderRules: Show Card title only in the Popup header and related-project contexts.
Show the transformation title once in the Hero.
Show at most three Problem Type chips.
Show Scope, Audience and Timeline only; never render Type.
Render Primary and Secondary Audience on separate lines.
Do not render Scale when scaleEvidence is empty.
Do not repeat Value I brought, At a glance, Critical problem or Business impact later in the page.

phasedValidationPath.desktop: Flash Voucher phase card | evidence bridge | Voucher Center phase card; carry-forward mapping below
rules: Use the real Flash Voucher and Voucher Center product assets.
Do not render a fabricated conversion chart.
Do not show a specific conversion rate.
Do not claim sponsor adoption, sponsor funding or revenue uplift.
Flash Voucher detail expands inside the current Popup; no nested Popup.
Legacy Product Evolution must not render as a separate full section.

title.en: Research changed the interaction model
title.zh: 研究如何改變互動模型

rules: Render one comparison component, not separate repeated research cards.
Search evidence must not appear here because it belongs to Voucher Wallet under Voucher / Offer Vision.
Research participant counts are evidence, not Scale.
Show exact research counts; do not convert them into approximate product metrics.
Render exactly two primary Decisions.
Decision 1 proves task-specific discovery and Checkout application.
Decision 2 proves the focused first-release trade-off.
Do not render the migrated Wallet Search decision.
Each Decision uses one primary visual, one evidence statement, one ownership line and one explicit status.
Core Decision text is vertical on mobile; do not use a horizontal carousel for the body.

title.en: What shipped—and what remains
title.zh: 已上線範圍與後續方向

rules: Shipped capabilities, future direction and not-shipped items appear once in this matrix.
Do not repeat the same delivered or confirmed lists in the Project Closure section.
Keep Claim all under Not shipped.
Keep the full consolidated architecture under Next direction or Not shipped according to canonical status.
Do not confuse shipped Claim → View with future Claim → Shop → Apply.

title.en: What became reusable
title.zh: 哪些能力被轉化為可重用基礎

rules: Combine the red/green visual hierarchy and reusable behaviour foundations into one system section.
Do not render Visual System Guardrail and System Foundation as two long independent sections.
Show one product visual and one compact capability map.
Colour never carries state or Voucher type alone.
Cross-reference the Voucher Card system; do not duplicate its full component specification.
Do not repeat the Hero role line.
Do not repeat shipped capability bullets already shown in Product Scope.
Show the sponsor-outcome measurement boundary.
Status and claim boundaries must use text, not colour alone.
Use existing related-project cards and canonical project IDs.
No dead links and no nested Popup.

title.en: Building repeat game-and-reward habits across the customer journey
title.zh: 在顧客旅程中建立可重複的遊戲獎勵習慣

atAGlance.en: As Sole and Primary Product Designer, led 0→1 strategy, phase planning, customer and Back Office design, stakeholder alignment and Engineering handoff for a configurable multi-game platform.
atAGlance.zh: 作為唯一且主要產品設計師，主導可配置多遊戲平台的 0→1 策略、階段規劃、顧客端與後台設計、利害關係人對齊及工程交付。

scope.en: Platform-level game discovery, concurrent campaign hosting, Operations configuration, lifecycle states and reward continuity.
scope.zh: 平台層級的遊戲探索、活動並行承載、營運設定、生命週期狀態與獎勵連續性。

audience.en:
Primary: FairPrice App customers playing reward games
Secondary: Platform Operations teams managing game content and visibility
audience.zh:
主要：在 FairPrice App 參與獎勵遊戲的顧客
次要：管理遊戲內容與顯示狀態的平台營運團隊

infoGrid.scope_zh: 平台層級的遊戲探索、活動設定、生命週期狀態與獎勵連續性

whyItMattered.en: Game discovery depended on isolated promotional entry points and one active slot, making repeat play hard to build and forcing sponsor campaigns to wait for one another.
whyItMattered.zh: 遊戲探索依賴零散的活動入口與單一上架版位，難以培養重複遊玩，也迫使贊助活動依序等待。

businessImpact.en: Enabled concurrent sponsor campaigns and Operations-controlled listing changes without requiring a new front-end release for every game.
businessImpact.zh: 支援多個贊助活動並行，並讓營運團隊可調整列表內容，不必為每個遊戲重新發布前端版本。

confidentialityNote.en: *Metrics are rounded or abstracted for confidentiality.*
confidentialityNote.zh: *基於保密考量，數據已四捨五入或以約略值呈現。*

singleGameConstraint.en: The existing direct entry supported one game at a time, creating fatigue risk, limiting preference coverage and preventing concurrent sponsor campaigns.
singleGameConstraint.zh: 既有直接入口一次只支援一個遊戲，造成疲乏風險、無法涵蓋不同偏好，也限制多個贊助單位活動同時進行。

upperFunnel.conflict: A separate JIRA preview states 19% of active users were players.

signals: Only about 1,000 users clicked into mini games from the X4U / Explore surface.
Game awareness depended heavily on push notifications and EDM.
Only about 50% of mini-game users also used Scan@Door.
Only about 15% of Scan@Door users played mini games.

vision.en: Build a repeat game-and-reward loop: a persistent Game Center, contextual entry points across the customer journey, and scalable sponsor-funded campaigns that return rewards into the Voucher experience.
vision.zh: 建立可重複的遊戲獎勵循環：以常設 Game Center、顧客旅程中的情境入口，以及可擴展的贊助活動，將獎勵帶回優惠券體驗。

primary: CTR from Game Center to an activity
Number of games played per user

upperFunnelMindsets: Recovery after failing to earn a reward
Continuous success after order or payment completion

phase1_1.name: Concurrent mini-games foundation
scope: Up to four games in the first rollout
Login prompt when a logged-out user starts a game
Support for single-play and repeatable games
Reuse of existing game-play and reward-result flows
Rewarded Voucher placed first in the Voucher swimlane
Existing deeplink, start date, provider URL, campaign ID and daily limit retained
knownLimitations: Repeat taps could return users to the reward-result page
No multi-category structure in the first rollout

phase1_2.name: Lifecycle communication and resilient game-card states
finalAgreedScope: Cooldown timer showing when a single-play game becomes available again
Sort completed single-play games to the bottom of the list
Return a game to the active state when it becomes playable again
No completed state for immediately repeatable games
Reward-result continuity with View Voucher and Shop Now actions
Reward Voucher returned to the first card in the Voucher swimlane
Responsive behaviour across supported screen widths
explicitlyParkedOrRemovedFromThisScope: 2x2 card layout - parked as a separate continuous-improvement item
Category title - removed because only one category existed
notConfirmedInFinalDeploymentScope: Long-term reward variants such as Linkpoints and Lucky Draw

publicBoundary.en: Design, alignment and Engineering development were completed; deployment was planned for early 2026, but final production release is not confirmed.
publicBoundary.zh: 設計、對齊與工程開發 均已完成，原定於 2026 年初部署，但目前尚未確認最終正式環境上線。

scope: Integration of challenges and lucky draws

title.en: From a single direct entry to a central multi-game hub
title.zh: 從單一直接入口，到中央多遊戲中心

whatIDecided.en: Replace the single-game entry with a dedicated listing page that could expose multiple active games and preserve each game's existing play flow.
whatIDecided.zh: 以專屬列表頁取代單一遊戲入口，讓多個進行中的遊戲可同時被探索，並保留各遊戲既有的遊玩流程。

whyThisChoice.en: One featured game could not serve different preferences or multiple sponsors, and changing the featured game caused customers to miss other opportunities.
whyThisChoice.zh: 單一主打遊戲無法同時服務不同偏好與多個贊助單位；替換主打遊戲也會讓顧客錯過其他機會。

title.en: From a broad gamification vision to a focused concurrent-games release
title.zh: 從廣泛遊戲化願景，到聚焦多遊戲並行的首版

whatIDecided.en: Prioritised multi-game hosting and configurable listing content, while reusing existing gameplay and reward-result flows for the first release.
whatIDecided.zh: 首版優先交付多遊戲承載與可配置的列表內容，同時沿用既有遊玩與獎勵結果流程。

whyThisChoice.en: Concurrent hosting was the immediate customer and sponsor bottleneck; completion tracking, reward history, filters and richer categorisation would add dependencies without solving that core constraint.
whyThisChoice.zh: 並行承載是當下最直接的顧客與贊助單位瓶頸；完成追蹤、獎勵歷史紀錄、篩選與更多分類會增加依賴，卻不直接解決核心限制。

content.en: We accepted one category, no completion state and limited game metadata in exchange for launching concurrent game discovery quickly and preserving existing game integrations.
content.zh: 我們接受單一分類、沒有完成狀態與較少的遊戲中繼資料，以換取更快上線多遊戲探索，並保留既有遊戲整合。

title.en: From a fixed game tile to an operator-configured listing
title.zh: 從固定遊戲卡片，到由營運團隊配置列表

whatIDecided.en: Extended the existing back office with game image, description and visibility controls while retaining existing campaign and deep-link fields.
whatIDecided.zh: 在既有後台加入遊戲圖片、說明與顯示控制，同時保留活動與深層連結欄位。

whyThisChoice.en: Running several games in parallel required Operations to control what appeared in the listing without a new front-end release for every campaign change.
whyThisChoice.zh: 多個遊戲平行執行時，營運團隊必須能控制列表顯示內容，而不需每次活動改動都重新發布前端。

title.en: From identical game cards to lifecycle-aware states
title.zh: 從狀態相同的遊戲卡片，到理解遊戲生命週期的狀態

whatIDecided.en: Defined distinct active, expiring, completed, cooldown, empty, loading and failure states, with different behaviour for single-play and immediately repeatable games.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義進行中、即將到期、已完成、冷卻中、空白、載入中與失敗狀態，並為單次遊玩與可立即重玩的遊戲設定不同邏輯。

whyThisChoice.en: The first release could not explain whether a game was still playable, already completed or temporarily unavailable. Single-play games needed recovery timing and reward access, while repeatable games needed to remain immediately actionable.
whyThisChoice.zh: 首版無法清楚說明遊戲是否仍可玩、已完成或暫時不可用；單次遊玩遊戲需要恢復時間與獎勵存取，而可重複遊戲則必須維持立即可操作。

title.en: From adding more layout density to clarifying urgency within the existing list
title.zh: 從增加版面密度，到在既有列表中強化急迫性

whatIDecided.en: Kept the full-width list for the Phase 1.2 delivery, removed an unnecessary category heading and moved expiry information into prominent card-level states; the proposed 2x2 layout was separated into another improvement initiative.
whatIDecided.zh: 第 1.2 階段維持全寬列表，移除不必要的分類標題，並將到期資訊提升為明顯的卡片狀態；2×2 版面則拆分為另一項改善。

whyThisChoice.en: Scroll analysis showed a visibility gap for lower-positioned games, while the active product still had only one category. The agreed release focused on clearer game status and urgency without mixing in a separate layout redesign.
whyThisChoice.zh: 捲動分析顯示較後方遊戲存在可見性落差，而產品當時仍只有一個分類；本次交付聚焦於更清楚的遊戲狀態與急迫性，不混入另一套版面改版。

title.en: Build a repeat game-and-reward loop across the customer journey
title.zh: 在顧客旅程中建立可重複的遊戲獎勵循環

whatIDecided.en: Use Game Center as the persistent destination, then surface relevant game entry points at high-opportunity moments such as Rewards, Voucher discovery and order or payment completion, returning earned Vouchers into the existing reward journey.
whatIDecided.zh: 以 Game Center 作為常設目的地，再於獎勵、優惠券探索、訂單或付款完成等高機會時刻提供相關遊戲入口，並將獲得的優惠券帶回既有獎勵旅程。

whyThisChoice.en: A destination alone could organise games but would not create a habit. Timely entry points could connect shopping success, recovery and reward-seeking mindsets to a repeat play-and-earn loop.
whyThisChoice.zh: 只有目的地能整理遊戲，卻不足以養成習慣；在適當時機提供入口，才能將購物成功、失敗復原與尋找獎勵的心態串成重複遊玩與獲獎循環。

content.en: The persistent Game Center shipped. The full cross-journey entry network remained a strategic expansion direction; exact shipped placements require item-level confirmation.
content.zh: 常設 Game Center 已上線；完整跨旅程入口網路仍屬策略擴展方向，各入口是否上線需逐項確認。

title.en: Launch the minimum platform needed for multiple games
title.zh: 先交付多遊戲並行所需的最小平台

whatIDecided.en: Ship multiple-game hosting, a configurable listing and existing play-to-reward flows first; defer completion tracking, reward history, filters and richer categories.
whatIDecided.zh: 首版先交付多遊戲承載、可配置列表與既有遊玩至獎勵流程；完成追蹤、獎勵歷史、篩選與更多分類則延後。

whyThisChoice.en: Concurrent hosting was the immediate bottleneck for customer choice and campaign capacity. The deferred features added dependencies without unlocking more active games.
whyThisChoice.zh: 多遊戲並行是顧客選擇與活動承載量的直接瓶頸；延後功能會增加依賴，卻不能先增加可同時上架的遊戲。

content.en: Accepted one category, no completion state and limited metadata in exchange for launching up to four games quickly while preserving existing game integrations.
content.zh: 接受單一分類、沒有完成狀態與有限中繼資料，以換取快速上線最多四個遊戲並保留既有遊戲整合。

tradeOff.notChosen: Full gamification, tracking and categorisation system at launch
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Less lifecycle clarity and navigation depth in the first release
tradeOff.protectedValue: Faster multi-game launch and lower integration risk
tradeOff.constraint: First-rollout timeline and existing game integrations

title.en: Make sponsor-funded game campaigns easier to launch in parallel
title.zh: 降低贊助遊戲活動並行上線的門檻

whatIDecided.en: Support concurrent sponsor games and extend the existing Back Office with image, description and visibility controls, while keeping each game's campaign, deep-link, provider and daily-limit setup.
whatIDecided.zh: 支援多個贊助遊戲並行，並在既有後台加入圖片、說明與顯示控制，同時保留各遊戲的活動、深層連結、供應商與每日次數設定。

whyThisChoice.en: Sponsors needed flexible campaign timing and reliable reward placement. A single slot and front-end-dependent updates limited how many partners could run games and provide Voucher rewards at the same time.
whyThisChoice.zh: 贊助單位需要彈性的活動時程與可靠的獎勵呈現；單一版位與依賴前端更新，限制了同時合作並提供優惠券獎勵的夥伴數量。

content.en: The configurable campaign foundation shipped. Do not claim increased sponsor count, sponsorship revenue or Voucher supply without measured evidence.
content.zh: 可配置活動基礎已上線；在缺少衡量證據前，不得主張贊助單位數、贊助收入或優惠券供給已提升。

multiGameParticipation.measurementPeriod: 10 weekly periods from 7 August to 15 October 2025
multiGameParticipation.numerator: Unique mini-game players who engaged with two or more distinct mini games during the measured week.
multiGameParticipation.denominator: Unique mini-game players who engaged with at least one mini game during the same measured week.
excludedDenominators: All Game Center page visitors who did not start a game

denominatorEvidence.weeklyTracking: The GTM sheet pairs the percentage metric with weekly mini-game player counts.
denominatorEvidence.dailySupportingView: The supporting engagement chart segments users who engaged with games into one-, two- and three-game groups on the same day.

publicClaim.en: Across the 10-week tracking period, roughly 70% of weekly mini-game players engaged with two or more games—about 20 percentage points above the 50% target.

gamificationPenetration.interpretation: approximately stable; about +0.3 percentage points using the rounded before/after values
gamificationPenetration.printedChangeConflict: The performance deck prints +2.4%, which does not reconcile with 22.68% to 23%.
gamificationPenetration.publicUse: Do not claim material growth until the metric definition is confirmed.

voucherVolumes.attributionBoundary: Campaign mix changed between the comparison periods; do not attribute all movement to the listing page.

gmv.sourceSummary: The deck compares Finest Fest 1 with Finest Fest 2 plus Kopitiam and includes annualised GMV and uplift figures.

sameDayEngagementEvidence.sourceFinding: 19,349 unique users engaged with every available game on the listing page on the same day, reported as +248.4% in the internal view.
sameDayEngagementEvidence.distributionInterpretation: The daily stacked chart groups engaged players by the number of distinct games played, confirming that the cohort is game-engaged users rather than all page visitors.
sameDayEngagementEvidence.publicUse: Do not publish the +248.4% until its comparison baseline is confirmed.

visibilityEvidence.sourceFinding: The internal scroll analysis indicated that roughly 22% of users did not scroll far enough to reach the third game.
visibilityEvidence.designImplication: Phase 1.2 prioritised clearer card-level urgency and lifecycle communication; a denser 2x2 layout was parked as a separate continuous-improvement item.
visibilityEvidence.publicUse: May be described qualitatively or with an approximate 20% figure after confidentiality review.

dimensions.reason: The single-game-to-platform transformation is immediate and concrete.
The case connects customer discovery, sponsor concurrency, Operations configuration and lifecycle states.
Sole design ownership and PM boundaries are explicit; the first-release trade-off is credible.
The approximately 70% multi-game participation result is strong and well-defined; secondary metrics remain unresolved.
Stakeholder and Engineering leadership are shown, but executive adoption, multi-team reuse and mentoring evidence are still limited.
The operating-model change is clear, but sponsorship revenue, campaign throughput or dependency reduction are not quantified.
Shipped flows, Back Office, resilience states, responsive behaviour and accessibility-scale handling are documented.
The evidence is strong but must be pruned into three decisions and one system-proof block.

criticalGaps: No quantified sponsor, revenue, campaign-throughput or operational-efficiency impact.
No evidence yet that the platform model changed priorities across multiple teams or was adopted beyond this product.
No mentoring, quality-bar or design-organisation influence within this case.
Phase 1.2 final production release remains unconfirmed.
Secondary performance and GMV tables remain unreconciled.

title.en: Separate end-of-day excess monitoring from real-time exception handling
title.zh: 區分日終額度超限監控與即時授信例外處理

whatIDecided.en: Defined two workflows: end-of-day excess monitoring for report review, prioritisation and follow-up; and real-time credit-exception handling for immediate case intake, delegated approval and disposition.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義兩套流程：日終額度超限監控負責報表審查、優先排序與後續追蹤；即時授信例外處理則負責立即接收案件、依授權層級核准與案件處置。

whyThisChoice.en: The two workflows had different triggers, service urgency, evidence and decision rights. Treating them as one generic exception process obscured ownership and delayed action.
whyThisChoice.zh: 兩套流程的觸發條件、處理時效、判斷依據與決策權限不同；若合併為通用例外流程，會模糊責任並延誤處理。

evidence.en: Separate cross-market journeys and ranked pain points were produced and validated for both modes.
evidence.zh: 兩種模式均建立並驗證獨立的跨市場旅程與痛點排序。

title.en: Move from manual excess reports to role-based exception work queues
title.zh: 從人工超限報表，轉為依角色分流的例外案件佇列

whatIDecided.en: Structured CRM and CCU workspaces around prioritised exception queues, borrower and facility context, supporting documents, Delegation of Authority, actions, notifications and decision history.
whatIDecided.zh: 依優先排序的例外案件佇列、借款人與授信額度脈絡、佐證文件、授權層級、操作、通知與決策紀錄，建立 CRM 與 CCU 工作介面。

whyThisChoice.en: Manual filtering, incomplete case metadata and fragmented approval history forced each role to reconstruct the case before making a decision.
whyThisChoice.zh: 人工篩選、不完整案件資料與分散的核准紀錄，使每個角色都必須先重新拼湊案件才能決策。

evidence.en: The role-based dashboards, case views, actions, notifications and monitoring capabilities were launched.
evidence.zh: 依角色設計的儀表板、案件視圖、操作、通知與監控能力均已上線。

title.en: Create one traceable exception review and approval workflow
title.zh: 建立一套可追蹤的例外審查與核准流程

whatIDecided.en: Mapped one cross-role workflow linking exception triggers, RM, CRM, CCU and Operations through review, delegated approval, refer-back, rejection and case-closure outcomes.
whatIDecided.zh: 建立一套跨角色流程，串接例外觸發、RM、CRM、CCU 與營運團隊，涵蓋審查、授權核准、退回補充、拒絕與案件結案。

whyThisChoice.en: Each function saw only part of the case. Product and delivery teams needed one reference for ownership, decision rights, evidence, next actions and auditability.
whyThisChoice.zh: 各職能只能看到部分案件；產品與交付團隊需要一套共同依據，對齊責任、決策權、判斷證據、下一步與可稽核性。

evidence.en: The earlier architecture and detailed new flow were created specifically for internal Product and cross-department communication.
evidence.zh: 早期系統架構與後續詳細流程，皆用於內部產品團隊與跨部門溝通。

primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Tested a collapsed single recommendation against a horizontal option list and selected the horizontal model, then simplified card hierarchy, repetitive USPs, default selection and sorting logic.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 測試收合式單一建議與橫向選項列表後，選擇橫向模型，並同步簡化卡片層級、重複價值主張、預設選擇與排序邏輯。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Customers wanted to see most options at a glance so they could compare price, capacity and value with each other and with other websites.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 顧客希望第一眼看到多數選項，以比較價格、乘載量與價值，也能與其他網站快速對照。

optionalThirdBlock.content: Accepted greater on-screen density instead of a tightly focused recommendation in exchange for faster cross-option comparison and less hidden choice.
optionalThirdBlock.content_zh: 接受較高的畫面資訊密度，而非高度聚焦的單一建議，以換取更快的跨選項比較與更少被隱藏的選擇。

supportingEvidence: Standard taxi defaulted for parties under four based on a year of GA booking distribution.
Taxi ordering combined passenger capacity with existing booking behaviour.
Key information and value propositions were prioritised for first-impression comparison.

ownership.en: Led the comparison model, hierarchy and interaction design; ordering and release logic were aligned with product, data and engineering.
ownership.zh: 主導比較模型、層級與互動設計；排序與上線邏輯則與產品團隊、數據及工程團隊對齊。

primaryDecisions.title: Prefill known trip details so travellers only confirm
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 預填既有旅程資料，讓旅客只需確認
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Prefilled hotel drop-off, flight pickup, passenger details and party-size taxi needs, while keeping each field editable.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 預填飯店下車地點、航班接送、乘客資料與依人數所需的車型，同時保留欄位可修改。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: Booking.com already held much of the trip information. Asking travellers to type it again slowed booking and increased avoidable errors.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: Booking.com 已掌握多數旅程資料；要求旅客再次輸入會拖慢預訂，也增加可避免的錯誤。
primaryDecisions.evidence: Flight-related findings were brought into weekly cross-vertical design sessions for alignment, brainstorming and critique.

ownership.en: Led the UX model for reusing trip data; data availability and cross-vertical integration were co-decided with adjacent product teams.
ownership.zh: 主導旅程資料重用的使用者體驗模型；資料可用性與跨產品整合則與相鄰產品團隊共同決定。

optionalThirdBlock.content: Required accommodation, flight and taxi teams to agree which trusted trip data could be carried forward and when customers still needed to confirm or edit it.
optionalThirdBlock.content_zh: 需要住宿、航班與計程車團隊共同確認哪些可信旅程資料可被延續，以及顧客何時仍需確認或修改。

supportingEvidence: The historical case selected prefilling from accommodation or other business-unit data because it offered higher data reachability and better use of limited resources.
Cross-vertical design sessions were used to review flight-related findings and connected-trip implications.

primaryDecisions.title: From universal pickup promises to staged, context-aware guidance
primaryDecisions.title_zh: 從通用接送承諾，到分階段、具情境的接送指引
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided: Translated luggage into cabin and checked-baggage terms, prioritised airport pickup guidance from Customer Service evidence and treated local road-closure prompts as a lower-priority, higher-cost extension.
primaryDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 將行李容量轉譯為隨身與托運行李，依客服證據優先處理機場接送指引，並將在地道路封閉提示視為成本較高、優先度較低的延伸。
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice: A single global wait-time promise could not account for airport layout, traffic, supplier dispatch and parking regulations across markets.
primaryDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 單一全球等候時間承諾無法涵蓋各市場的機場動線、交通、供應商派車與停車規定。

optionalThirdBlock.content: Accepted less personalised timing in the first step rather than publishing false precision, while using clearer precautions and Customer Service access until supplier-specific logic was feasible.
optionalThirdBlock.content_zh: 第一階段接受較不個人化的時間資訊，而不是提供錯誤精準度；在供應商-特定邏輯可行前，以更清楚的注意事項與客服存取補足。

ownership.en: Led the evidence synthesis and staged guidance direction; supplier-specific feasibility and rollout were shared product and operational decisions.
ownership.zh: 主導證據統整與分階段引導方向；供應商特定可行性與推行則為共同的產品與營運決策。

scope.en: End-to-end mobile and tablet experience covering level guidance, licensed-content discovery, access, personal libraries and sheet-music practice.
scope.zh: 涵蓋程度引導、授權內容探索、內容存取、個人譜庫與樂譜練習的端到端手機與平板體驗。

audience.en: Primary: Piano learners using guided content and sheet-music practice
audience.zh: 主要：使用分級內容與樂譜練習的鋼琴學習者

whyItMattered.en: Learners could not judge their level or connect licensed-content discovery to later practice, breaking learning continuity across mobile and tablet.
whyItMattered.zh: 學習者無法判斷自己的程度，也無法將授權內容探索連接到後續練習，使手機與平板的學習歷程中斷。

businessImpact.en: Created a reusable content, entitlement, library and practice architecture that supported catalogue growth across mobile and tablet without restructuring the core product.
businessImpact.zh: 建立可重用的內容、存取權限、個人譜庫與練習架構，使手機與平板能持續擴充內容，而不必重做核心產品。

title.en: From automated skill recognition to a shippable five-level model
title.zh: 從自動程度辨識，到可上線的五級模型

whatIDecided.en: Ship a five-level onboarding model and examination-category levels before investing in score recognition, music recognition and fingering assessment.
whatIDecided.zh: 先上線五級初始引導與檢定分類級別，再投入樂譜辨識、音樂辨識與指法評估。

whyThisChoice.en: Copyright, content classification and delivery constraints made recognition-dependent onboarding too risky for the first release.
whyThisChoice.zh: 版權、內容分類與交付限制，使依賴辨識技術的初始引導不適合首版。

content.en: Accepted a less personalised initial assessment to launch a coherent learning path earlier and avoid blocking the product on unresolved recognition and content dependencies.
content.zh: 接受較不個人化的初始評估，以更早上線完整學習路徑，避免產品被未解決的辨識與內容依賴阻塞。

How do you connect content discovery to practice?

publicSummary.en: Owned information architecture, interaction flows, wireframes and UX specifications across 12 core functions; research synthesis, product strategy, workshops and phase prioritisation were developed with the AJA consulting team and client.
publicSummary.zh: 負責 12 個核心功能的資訊架構、互動流程、線框稿與使用者體驗規格；研究統整、產品策略、工作坊及階段優先順序則與 AJA 顧問團隊及客戶共同完成。

ledByMe.zh: 12 項功能的使用者體驗規格

coDecided.zh: 第一階段功能優先順序

partnerOwned.zh: 客戶的商業與內容專業
顧問團隊的研究與策略協作

systemImpact.en: Connected level-setting, licensed-content discovery, entitlement, personal libraries and sheet practice into one mobile-and-tablet learning system rather than treating each feature as a separate screen.
systemImpact.zh: 將程度設定、授權內容探索、權限、個人譜庫與樂譜練習串成同一套行動裝置／平板學習系統，而非把功能當成彼此分離的畫面。

title.en: From a broad feature vision to a launchable learning loop
title.zh: 從廣泛功能願景，到可上線的學習核心循環

whatIDecided.en: Prioritised content exploration, level guidance, licensed sheet acquisition, personal-library access and practice as the first coherent product loop, while deferring advanced coaching, automatic recognition and broader community concepts.
whatIDecided.zh: 優先建立內容探索、程度引導、授權樂譜取得、個人譜庫與練習的完整首版循環，延後進階指導、自動辨識與更廣泛的社群概念。

whyThisChoice.en: The team needed a product that could ship across mobile and tablet using available content, coaching expertise and technical capabilities, rather than blocking the release on unresolved recognition and community dependencies.
whyThisChoice.zh: 團隊需要以既有內容、教學專業與技術能力，在行動裝置與平板上形成可上線產品，而不是被尚未解決的辨識與社群依賴阻塞。

content.en: Deferred more personalised recognition and coaching features to protect a coherent, deliverable first release.
content.zh: 延後更個人化的辨識與指導功能，以保護首版的一致性與可交付性。

evidence.en: The released scope covered mobile and tablet content exploration, store and sheet lists, examination-category levels, practice and an initial friend-invitation reward feature.
evidence.zh: 已上線範圍涵蓋行動裝置／平板的內容探索、商店與樂譜列表、檢定分類程度、練習，以及初版好友邀請獎勵功能。

impactAndOwnership.en: Owned the information architecture, flows, wireframes and UX specifications; phase prioritisation was developed with the consulting team and client.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 負責資訊架構、流程、線框稿與 UX 規格；階段優先順序則與顧問團隊及客戶共同完成。

title.en: From disconnected content screens to a connected entitlement-and-practice system
title.zh: 從分散內容畫面，到連結權限與練習的系統

whatIDecided.en: Structured discovery, store lists, purchase or download, personal libraries and sheet practice as connected states with explicit entry, access and practice relationships.
whatIDecided.zh: 將探索、商店清單、購買／下載、個人譜庫與樂譜練習定義為互相連結的狀態，明確處理入口、存取權與練習關係。

whyThisChoice.en: A learning platform could not create continuity if customers discovered licensed content in one area but could not understand how it became available for later practice.
whyThisChoice.zh: 若使用者在一處探索授權內容，卻無法理解內容如何進入後續練習，學習平台就無法形成連續體驗。

content.en: Required one information architecture across catalogue, transaction, entitlement, personal-library and practice states.
content.zh: 需要在 內容目錄、交易、存取權限、個人譜庫 與 練習 狀態之間建立同一套資訊架構。

evidence.en: The engagement delivered UX specifications across 12 core functions and flows and released the mobile and tablet redesign.
evidence.zh: 專案完成 12 個核心功能與流程的 UX 規格，並正式上架行動裝置與平板改版。

impactAndOwnership.en: Owned the architecture and detailed UX delivery; content, business and technical constraints were resolved with the client and consulting team.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 負責架構與詳細 UX 交付；內容、商業與技術限制則與客戶及顧問團隊共同解決。

claim.en: Released mobile and tablet redesign across the confirmed core learning and content flows.
claim.zh: 已上架行動裝置與平板改版，涵蓋已確認的核心學習與內容流程。

evidence: 12 core UX functions and flows specified

claim.en: Eight interview and usability-testing sessions informed segmentation, journey structure and phase prioritisation.
claim.zh: 8 場訪談與可用性測試支援使用者分群、旅程結構與階段優先順序。

outcomeEvidence.reason: The legacy portfolio retained these claims but no source definition, measurement window or attribution evidence is available.

title.zh: 治理端到端拍賣交易
