audience.en: Primary: Auction buyers and sellers
audience.zh: 主要：線上拍賣買家與賣家

infoGrid.scope_zh: 涵蓋買方、賣方、付款、物流與通知旅程的平台層級流程

whyItMattered.en: A payment feature without shared transaction states left buyer protection, seller operations, logistics and notifications open to conflicting interpretation across organisations.
whyItMattered.zh: 缺少共享交易狀態的付款功能，使買家保障、賣家營運、物流與通知在不同組織間產生衝突解讀。

businessImpact.en: Created one transaction regulation that reduced interpretation gaps between the banking client and software vendor across payment, logistics, notifications and service states.
businessImpact.zh: 建立一套交易規範，降低銀行客戶與軟體供應商在付款、物流、通知與服務狀態上的解讀落差。

designDecisions.title: From a third-party payment feature to a trusted transaction platform
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Expanded the initial payment brief into an auction service that supported seller setup, buyer protection and staged transaction operations.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: The bank’s trust advantage could create more value through a coherent marketplace journey than through an isolated payment function.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從第三方付款功能，到值得信任的拍賣交易平台
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 將原本的付款需求擴展為拍賣交易服務，涵蓋賣家設定、買家保障與分階段交易營運。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 銀行既有的信任優勢，透過一致的交易旅程能創造比單一付款功能更完整的價值。

designDecisions.title: From screen-by-screen rules to an end-to-end payment and logistics regulation
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Mapped every transaction phase, notification, interface state and response action into one shared regulation.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: Financial transactions crossed client, vendor, buyer and seller responsibilities; inconsistent state logic would create operational and implementation risk.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從逐頁規則，到端到端付款與物流規範
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 將每個交易階段、通知、介面狀態與回應動作整理成一套共享規範。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 金融交易橫跨客戶、軟體供應商、買家與賣家責任；若狀態邏輯不一致，會增加營運與實作風險。
designDecisions.evidence: The Excel regulation was repeatedly reviewed with the client and software vendor and became the reference for further development.

designDecisions.title: From separate UX and UI production to reusable patterns
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Used UI-defined patterns inside high-fidelity UX wireframes so more interfaces could be delivered consistently despite a single UI Designer.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: The project scope exceeded the available UI resource and required a shared pattern model to protect delivery speed.

optionalThirdBlock.content: Accepted heavier UX specification effort in exchange for reducing the UI bottleneck and preserving implementation consistency.

designDecisions.title_zh: 從分離的 UX／UI 製作，到可重用的介面模式
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 在高擬真 UX 線框稿中套用 UI 設計師定義的模式，使單一 UI 設計師的情況下仍能一致交付更多介面。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 專案範圍超過現有 UI 資源，需要共享模式模型來維持交付速度與一致性。

atAGlance.en: Led UX redesign of Cathay Life Insurance’s internal tablet mortgage app for junior-to-mid-level sales staff, translating research into scenario-led consultation, mortgage estimation and implementation-ready specifications.
atAGlance.zh: 主導國泰人壽內部平板房貸工具改版，服務初階至中階銷售人員，將研究轉化為情境式諮詢、房貸估算與可直接實作的規格。

scope.en: Internal tablet consultation covering customer-needs assessment, mortgage estimation, property information, scenario guidance, validation and developer handoff.

whyItMattered.en: The tablet app enforced a fixed orientation flow, but mortgage sales worked in mobile, conversational settings and needed timely estimates and useful talking points from fragmented departmental data.

clientAndDelivery.en: Aligned concepts with the client and handed implementation-ready flows and wireframes to development.
clientAndDelivery.zh: 與客戶對齊概念，並將可實作的流程與線框稿交付開發。

title.en: From a fixed tablet orientation to a flexible consultation flow
title.zh: 從固定的平板引導，到彈性的房貸諮詢流程

whatIDecided.en: Reorganised the existing app around scenario-based conversations so sales staff could assess customer needs, explain mortgage estimates and move between relevant guidance without following one rigid script.
whatIDecided.zh: 以情境式對話重新組織既有 App，讓銷售人員能評估客戶需求、說明房貸估算，並依實際對話切換相關引導，而不是被單一路徑限制。

whyThisChoice.en: The original orientation did not match how sales staff developed real customer conversations and created unnecessary cognitive workload during consultation.
whyThisChoice.zh: 原本的操作引導不符合銷售人員與客戶實際互動的方式，也在諮詢過程中增加不必要的認知負擔。

content.en: The redesign had to simplify the consultation experience without breaking the employee orientation process tied to the existing app.
content.zh: 改版必須在不破壞既有員工操作引導的前提下，降低諮詢流程的負擔。

zh: 訪談逐字稿與 同理心圖
四項任務的可用性測試

impactAndOwnership.en: I led the concept, prototype, wireframes and developer handoff; the redesigned app launched for internal use.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 我主導概念、原型、線框稿與開發交接；改版後的 App 已正式上線供內部使用。

title.en: From fragmented departmental inputs to one consultation structure
title.zh: 從分散的部門資訊，到一套共享的諮詢結構

whatIDecided.en: Defined the app structure, function tree and information requirements that organised available customer, mortgage and marketing inputs into one consultation sequence, while documenting data dependencies for delivery.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義 App 架構、功能樹與資訊需求，將可用的客戶、房貸與行銷資訊整理進同一套諮詢順序，並清楚記錄交付所需的資料依賴。

whyThisChoice.en: Relevant information was distributed across departmental databases, so the team needed one shared model before interface and development decisions could stay consistent.
whyThisChoice.zh: 相關資訊分散在不同部門資料庫，因此團隊需要先建立共同模型，才能讓介面與開發決策保持一致。

content.en: This required clarifying which information was available, which dependencies remained outside the app and how each input supported the consultation.
content.zh: 這項決策需要先釐清哪些資訊可取得、哪些依賴仍在 App 之外，以及各項資訊如何支援諮詢流程。

zh: App 架構與 網站地圖
供開發使用的註解式 線框稿

impactAndOwnership.en: I created the UX structure and delivery specification used by the UI Designer, client and development team.
impactAndOwnership.zh: 我建立 UX 架構與交付規格，供 UI 設計師、客戶與開發團隊共同使用。

title.en: From research handoff to a validated, system-aligned delivery
title.zh: 從研究交接，到經驗證且符合既有系統的設計交付

whatIDecided.en: Translated interview findings into user scenarios, a prototype and implementation-ready wireframes, then refined the direction through a four-task usability test before handoff.
whatIDecided.zh: 將訪談發現轉化為使用情境、原型與可實作線框稿，並在交接前透過四項任務的可用性測試修正方向。

whyThisChoice.en: The redesign had to work in real sales conversations, satisfy client expectations and remain compatible with Cathay’s established component system.
whyThisChoice.zh: 改版必須能用於真實銷售對話、符合客戶期待，並與國泰既有元件系統相容。

content.en: This required close collaboration with the Researcher, UI Designer, Project Manager and client across synthesis, workshops, prototype production and final alignment.
content.zh: 這需要與研究員、UI 設計師、專案經理與客戶密切合作，完成研究統整、工作坊、原型製作與最終對齊。

zh: 客戶 創意發想 與 對齊工作坊
可供開發使用的狀態與流程說明

impactAndOwnership.zh: 我負責 UX 概念、原型、線框稿與交接，並與 UI 設計師協作視覺執行。

cathay-mortgage-assistant.transformation: Reframing tablet mortgage consultations around real sales conversations
cathay-mortgage-assistant.transformation_zh: 以真實銷售對話重整平板房貸諮詢
cathay-mortgage-assistant.at_glance: Led UX redesign of Cathay Life Insurance’s internal tablet mortgage app for junior-to-mid-level sales staff, translating research into scenario-led consultation, mortgage estimation and implementation-ready specifications.
cathay-mortgage-assistant.at_glance_zh: 主導國泰人壽內部平板房貸工具改版，服務初階至中階銷售人員，將研究轉化為情境式諮詢、房貸估算與可直接實作的規格。
cathay-mortgage-assistant.why: The tablet app enforced a fixed orientation flow, but mortgage sales worked in mobile, conversational settings and needed timely estimates and useful talking points from fragmented departmental data.
cathay-mortgage-assistant.why_zh: 平板工具依循固定操作引導，但房貸銷售多在行動、對話式情境工作，且需要從分散部門資料取得即時估算與可延續對話的資訊。
cathay-mortgage-assistant.impact: Created one consultation structure connecting customer needs, mortgage estimation, property information and scenario guidance, giving the client and development team a shared implementation reference.
cathay-mortgage-assistant.impact_zh: 建立串接顧客需求、房貸估算、房產資訊與情境引導的諮詢架構，讓客戶與開發團隊共用同一份實作依據。

headline.en: Converted researcher-led interview evidence into a scenario-based tablet consultation model, validated through four usability-test tasks.
headline.zh: 將研究員執行的訪談證據轉化為情境式平板諮詢模型，並透過四項可用性測試任務完成驗證。

supportingStatement.zh: 交付 App 架構、使用情境、原型、功能樹、涵蓋狀態的線框稿與開發註記，供後續實作。

measurementBoundary.zh: 目前沒有員工採用或銷售量化成果；已上線的諮詢模式與可用性驗證是已確認成果。

criticalProblems.en: The App did not support the outdoor and remote situations in which sales staff developed customer relationships.
criticalProblems.zh: 工具未支援銷售人員在外出與遠端情境中經營客戶的工作方式。

criticalProblems.en: Interest rates and split-loan estimates could not be explained simply and accurately for different customer types during the conversation.
criticalProblems.zh: 面對不同客戶類型時，利率與分拆貸款估算無法在對話中簡單且準確地說明。

criticalProblems.en: Sales staff lacked relevant information and prompts for sustaining useful customer conversations.

atAGlance.en: As the only dedicated designer in a three-person core team, led 0→1 design of one payment journey across the FairPrice App, cashier and self-checkout.
atAGlance.zh: 作為三人核心團隊中唯一的專任設計師，主導串接 FairPrice App、人工收銀與自助結帳的 0→1 付款旅程。

scope.en: End-to-end App payment, cashier and self-checkout operations, recovery, refunds, frontline readiness, monitoring and post-purchase records.
scope.zh: 涵蓋 App 付款、人工與自助結帳營運、錯誤復原、退款、第一線準備、監控與購後紀錄。

主要：透過 App 付款的 FairPrice 購物者
次要：收銀員、自助結帳支援人員、店長與客服人員

infoGrid.scope_zh: 涵蓋顧客探索、行動支付、人工與自助結帳營運、失敗處理、第一線準備、衡量方式與購後紀錄的端到端 0→1 範圍

whyItMattered.en: FairPrice had no dependable end-to-end payment baseline across App, cashier and self-checkout; failures, refunds, training and monitoring were handled inconsistently across teams.
whyItMattered.zh: FairPrice 缺少能跨 App、人工收銀與自助結帳運作的端到端付款基礎；錯誤、退款、培訓與監控也由各團隊不一致地處理。

businessImpact.en: Established a shared payment operating standard for Product, stores, training and monitoring, allowing the retail network to scale without redefining the journey for each checkout channel.
businessImpact.zh: 建立供產品、門市、培訓與監控共同使用的付款營運標準，使零售網路擴展時不必為每種結帳通路重新定義旅程。

Cash or card while earning and redeeming LinkPoints

designDecisions.title: From separate loyalty and payment steps to one checkout identity
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Connected app QR payment, LinkPoints, discounts and available vouchers so customers could see applied value and complete checkout with fewer cards and fewer visible steps.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: Research showed checkout decisions were shaped by speed, reassurance and queue pressure, while customers struggled to understand LinkPoints and voucher use at self-checkout.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從分離的忠誠與付款步驟，到單一結帳識別
designDecisions.whatIDecided_zh: 連結 App QR 付款、LinkPoints、折扣與可用優惠券，讓顧客能看見已套用價值，並以更少卡片與更少步驟完成結帳。
designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 研究顯示，結帳決策受到速度、安心感與排隊壓力影響；顧客也難以理解在自助結帳時如何使用 LinkPoints 與優惠券。
designDecisions.evidence: The visible self-checkout journey was reduced from 9 to 6 steps and cardless checkout scaled across about 190 stores.

designDecisions.title: From ambiguous QR interactions to channel-specific guidance
designDecisions.whatIDecided: Refined SCO entry placement, changed instructions from scanning to showing a QR code, simplified value-proposition copy and reduced competing CTA attention during kiosk processing.
designDecisions.whyThisChoice: Testing showed users noticed the entry but hesitated, confused Scan & Go with QR generation, tapped the wrong screen and did not understand the Go Back path.
designDecisions.title_zh: 從模糊的 QR 互動，到依通路設計的操作引導

designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 測試顯示，使用者雖看見入口卻仍會猶豫，混淆 Scan & Go 與 QR 產生方式、點錯畫面，也不了解返回路徑。
designDecisions.evidence: Version C was noticed by 4/6 users versus 2/6 for Version B; the revised Show your QR code instruction improved action comprehension.

designDecisions.title: From a successful payment screen to an end-to-end recovery and operations model

designDecisions.whyThisChoice: A dependable payment foundation had to remain understandable and actionable when transactions failed, required refunds, or moved into staff, support and finance workflows.

designDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 可靠的付款基礎必須在交易失敗、需要退款，或進入門市、客服與財務流程時，仍然清楚且可採取行動。

supportingValidatedDecisions.title: From one generic order list to labeled transaction histories
supportingValidatedDecisions.whatIDecided: Used separate labeled histories for Online Grocery, Scan & Go and app payment as the interim model, while preserving a future path toward a unified labeled history.
supportingValidatedDecisions.whyThisChoice: Users wanted clear category differences during transition; ~86% found the separate labeled version more intuitive than mixing new payment records into the existing list.

optionalThirdBlock.content: We prioritised immediate discoverability and lower transition risk, while deferring a unified one-page history model because the future-direction sample was not sufficient for a final architecture decision.

supportingValidatedDecisions.whyThisChoice_zh: 用戶在轉換期間需要清楚辨識不同類別；約 86% 認為分開且有標籤的版本，比把新付款紀錄混入既有清單更直覺。

title.en: From isolated complaints to an end-to-end opportunity model
title.zh: 從零散抱怨，到端到端機會模型

whatIDecided.en: Combined internal evidence, customer pain points, traffic signals and stakeholder constraints into one journey spanning referral, identity, KYC, account verification and completion.
whatIDecided.zh: 將內部證據、顧客痛點、流量訊號與利害關係人限制整合成一條旅程，涵蓋推薦、身分驗證、KYC、帳戶驗證與完成階段。

whyThisChoice.en: The three most persistent problems - bank authentication, document upload and invisible referral binding - crossed multiple screens and teams, so a screen-by-screen redesign would not resolve the system causes.
whyThisChoice.zh: 最持續的三類問題——銀行身分驗證、文件上傳與推薦關係綁定不可見——橫跨多個畫面與團隊，因此逐頁改版無法處理系統成因。

evidence.en: The journey separated applicant, referral-agent and Customer Service responsibilities and recorded confirmed pain points, opportunities and unresolved dependencies by stage.
evidence.zh: 旅程依階段拆分申請人、推薦人與客服責任，並記錄已確認痛點、改善機會與尚未解決的依賴。

title.en: Check referral, identity and account requirements before the long application
title.zh: 在正式填表前先確認推薦、身分與開戶要求

whatIDecided.en: Show referral requirements, identity-verification route, bank or e-payment verification and required documents before the long form, then save progress at completed stages for later resumption.
whatIDecided.zh: 在長表單前先說明推薦條件、身分驗證路徑、銀行或電子支付驗證與必備文件，再以完成階段為單位保存進度供後續續辦。

whyThisChoice.en: Early checks prevent applicants from completing most of the form only to discover an incompatible route or missing requirement, while stage-level persistence avoids a full restart after external handoffs.
whyThisChoice.zh: 前置確認可避免申請人填完大部分內容後，才發現路徑不適用或資料不足；階段式保存也能避免外部交接後整段重填。

content.en: Accepted stage-level rather than field-level recovery because only completed stages could be stored, reducing full-flow restarts while preserving implementation and compliance feasibility.
content.zh: 因系統只能保存已完成的階段，我們接受以階段為單位而非欄位為單位復原，在維持實作與法遵可行性的同時，降低整段重填。

tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Applicants may need to re-enter an unfinished stage
tradeOff.protectedValue: Feasible, compliant recovery that prevents full-flow restart
tradeOff.constraint: Only completed stages could be retained for one month

title.en: From opaque verification failures to explicit handoffs and recovery states
title.zh: 從不透明的驗證失敗，到明確交接與復原狀態

whatIDecided.en: Specified preparation, phone matching, document purpose, OCR review, retry limits, redirect states and fallback actions across identity, bank and e-payment verification.
whatIDecided.zh: 針對身分、銀行帳戶與電子支付驗證，完整定義事前準備、電話匹配、文件用途、OCR 審查、重試次數、重新導向狀態與替代操作。

whyThisChoice.en: Generic errors and hidden external requirements made applicants unable to diagnose failure or decide whether to retry, switch routes or resume later.
whyThisChoice.zh: 通用錯誤訊息與隱藏的外部條件，使申請人無法判斷失敗原因，也無法決定重試、改走其他路徑或稍後繼續。

evidence.en: The target flow documented mobile/tablet and desktop behaviour, error thresholds, external redirects and application-status outcomes before detailed UI specification.
evidence.zh: 目標流程在詳細介面規格前，已定義行動裝置、平板與桌面版行為、錯誤門檻、外部重新導向與申請狀態結果。

commonPainPoints: Cathay United Bank online-banking authentication failed or was difficult to complete.
Identity-document photography, upload and cropping were unreliable or unclear.
Referral information was not visibly carried into the application or traceable.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Entry and expectation
examples: Applicants could not find the application entry.
Some arrived from unrelated activities without understanding the product.
Account and phone-number requirements were discovered too late.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Identity and document capture
examples: OTP could not be received despite correct bank records.
Photo upload, cropping and camera use failed.
Generic parameter errors did not explain the failure.
The purpose of dual-ID upload and signature files was unclear.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Forms and KYC
examples: Occupation and organisation choices were unclear for self-employed applicants.
Question volume felt excessive compared with securities onboarding.
Missing or invalid fields were not clearly anchored.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: External account authentication
examples: Available debit accounts were limited and discovered late.
External WebView and App redirects required credentials and matching phone numbers.
Forgotten credentials and time limits caused abandonment.

journeyPainPointClusters.label: Interruption and recovery
examples: Applicants could be forced to restart the full flow.
Incomplete stages and next actions were not clear.
Completion credentials and status communications were fragmented.

entryRoutes: Referral link generated by an agent
accountRoutes: Paper application fallback for applicants without an eligible account
crossDeviceCoverage: Mobile and tablet: camera capture, upload and online signature
Desktop: file upload and signature-file upload
recoveryModel: Completed stages can be saved for one month.
Applicants re-enter through identity and mobile OTP verification.
Progress view shows completed and incomplete stages.
Incomplete applicants can receive reminder communication.
External-authentication failure provides retry or later-resume paths.
exceptionCoverage: External WebView/App timeout or failed return

stakeholderConstraints.decisionEffect: Only completed stages are saved; incomplete fields within a stage are not retained. Records are retained for one month.

stakeholderConstraints.constraint: No referral-agent completion on behalf of applicants
stakeholderConstraints.decisionEffect: Stakeholders advised against agent-assisted application because of regulatory requirements.
Investment-risk information must be completed again for the investment-trust application and cannot simply be reused.
No separate high-risk-occupation journey was added; AML rejection remained rare, and manual calls for high-risk occupations were retained for audit evidence.
Cathay United Bank authentication could not be pre-opened or preserved because its link was not publicly accessible.
The flow had to prepare applicants for WebView/App redirects, credentials, matching phone numbers and explicit return actions.

included: Identity, document, OCR and signature flows
excludedOrNotPrioritised: Referral-agent application completion on behalf of customers
Reusing previously completed KYC instead of mandatory re-entry
Unconfirmed automated post-submission notifications to referral agents

title.en: Standardising investment-account review and remediation
title.zh: 標準化投信開戶審件與補件

scope.en: End-to-end application review, AML and name checks, high-risk approval, rejection or remediation, operational handoff and customer-status communication.
scope.zh: 涵蓋申請審查、防制洗錢與姓名檢核、高風險核准、退件或補件、營運交接與客戶狀態溝通。

majorPainPointClusters.label: Document and data review
evidence: Reviewers switched between pages to compare documents and entered data

majorPainPointClusters.label: External screening dependencies
evidence: Judicial website outages and scheduled-task failures
AML scans could take a long time
Common names required extended manual research
Results were stored separately and required page switching

majorPainPointClusters.label: Manual risk and list review
evidence: High-risk approval crossed departments and remained paper-heavy
Problem lists required record-by-record validation and notes
Reviewers used external search and manually documented decisions

majorPainPointClusters.label: System handoff and stock transfer
evidence: Stock-system import supported only five records at a time
Concurrent reviewers queued to avoid import errors
Address and employee-number corrections were tracked in notes and fixed later

majorPainPointClusters.label: Customer remediation and status
evidence: Applicants could not see detailed review progress
Remediation SMS did not take applicants directly to the failed step
Applicants had to re-enter the journey and search for the error
Long review times could cause applicants to miss an investment window

method: Mapped the existing review and remediation journey
Voted on the five highest-impact pain points
Synthesised recommendations into benefit and feasibility groups

Customer information cards and review-result filtering
Simplify manual comparison by review priority

expectedBenefitOrder: Shorten automated review and approval time
Simplify and clarify applicant status communication
executionDifficultyOrderLowToHigh: Notify referral agents about remediation status
Automatically classify lists and reduce manual review
Digitise the complete internal review process

opportunities: Keyword filtering for occupation and company risk

recommendedPhases.focus: Reduce repetitive manual review and operational handoffs

title.en: Turn reviewer and Operations know-how into one traceable remediation workflow
title.zh: 將審件與營運人員經驗整理成可追蹤的補件流程

whatIDecided.en: Mapped the five-phase review process across reviewer roles, internal systems, external checks, paper approvals, issue categories, required evidence, ownership, customer messages and next actions.
whatIDecided.zh: 盤點五階段審件流程，串接審件角色、內部系統、外部檢核、紙本簽核、問題分類、所需證明、負責人、顧客訊息與下一步。

whyThisChoice.en: Critical review knowledge lived in staff memory, screenshots, PDFs and notes. Making the workflow explicit reduced inconsistent interpretation and gave Product a reliable basis for prioritising remediation improvements.
whyThisChoice.zh: 關鍵審件知識分散在同仁記憶、截圖、PDF 與筆記中；將流程明確化可降低解讀不一致，也讓產品經理有可靠基礎排序補件改善。

evidence.en: The delivered process model made roles, systems, decisions, exception branches, evidence requirements and customer remediation visible in one traceable view.
evidence.zh: 交付的流程模型在同一可追蹤視圖中呈現角色、系統、決策、例外分支、證明要求與顧客補件。

title.en: From equal-weight feedback to benefit-and-feasibility prioritisation
title.zh: 從等權重回饋，到依效益與可行性排序

whatIDecided.en: Structured the workshop so participants first selected the highest-impact pain points, then rated opportunity difficulty separately before recommendations were synthesised.
whatIDecided.zh: 先從工作坊選出高影響痛點，再獨立評估改善機會的難度，最後才統整建議。

whyThisChoice.en: Operational urgency and engineering effort were being discussed together, making high-value problems difficult to distinguish from easy-to-build ideas.
whyThisChoice.zh: 營運急迫性與工程投入原本被混在一起討論，導致高價值問題與容易開發的想法難以區分。

evidence.en: The results exposed a wide feasibility range: keyword risk filtering was rated relatively accessible, while direct internal-system approval was the hardest opportunity.
evidence.zh: 結果顯示可行性差異明顯：關鍵字風險篩選相對容易，直接串接內部核准系統則最困難。

title.en: From all-at-once digitisation to phased optimisation recommendations
title.zh: 從一次完成全面數位化，到分階段優化建議

whatIDecided.en: Recommended sequencing input-quality and transparency improvements before list automation, stock-system optimisation and full internal-review digitisation.
whatIDecided.zh: 建議先改善輸入品質與透明度，再推進清單自動化、庫存系統優化與完整內部審查數位化。

whyThisChoice.en: The workshop showed that high-benefit structural changes also carried the greatest implementation difficulty, while several narrower interventions could reduce friction earlier.
whyThisChoice.zh: 工作坊顯示，高效益的結構性改善同時具有最高實作難度；較聚焦的介入則能更早降低操作阻力。

decisionStatusNote.en: The phased model was delivered as a planning recommendation. Client approval, implementation sequence and outcomes remain unconfirmed.
decisionStatusNote.zh: 分階段模型以規劃建議形式交付；客戶核准、實作順序與成果尚未確認。

label.zh: 未來營運模式・尚未實作

summary.en: The proposed future flow connected automated screening, internal review, customer remediation and stock-system handoff, but the workshop deck explicitly marked detailed content as pending team confirmation.
summary.zh: 提案中的未來流程串接自動篩選、內部審查、顧客補件與庫存系統交接，但工作坊資料明確標示細節仍待團隊確認。

claimBoundary: Do not present the ideal flow as approved or shipped.

title.en: My contribution

summary.en: I turned staff knowledge and existing evidence into a shared operating model, facilitated prioritisation and delivered recommendations the Product Manager could use to plan optimisation phases.

hero.purpose: Communicate operational complexity and the delivered system view within five seconds.
hero.recommendedContent: A public redraw of the five-phase review and remediation operating model, showing people, internal systems, external checks and major handoffs.

operatingBaseline.purpose: Prove the depth of current-state discovery.

operatingBaseline.avoid: Exact customer names, internal screen captures, database paths or dense source notes.

workshopPrioritisation.purpose: Show how competing opinions became an evidence-based priority model.

workshopPrioritisation.avoid: Participant names and exact internal vote markers.

futureRoadmap.purpose: Show sequencing rather than a speculative future-state screen.

futureRoadmap.avoid: Presenting the ideal workshop flow as approved or shipped.

title.en: Simplifying complex mortgage applications into online self-service
title.zh: 將複雜房貸申辦簡化為線上自助流程

atAGlance.en: Led 0→1 design of CTBC Bank’s online mortgage application, simplifying web, paper, document and related-party requirements into guided, resumable self-service.
atAGlance.zh: 主導中國信託房貸線上申辦的 0→1 設計，將網站、紙本、文件與關係人要求簡化為有引導、可續辦的自助流程。

scope.en: End-to-end self-service mortgage application covering entry, identity, property and loan data, related parties, consent, documents, status and resumption.
scope.zh: 涵蓋入口、身分、房產與貸款資料、關係人、同意、文件、狀態與續填的端到端自助房貸申請。

audience.en:
Primary: Mortgage applicants
Secondary: Co-borrowers and guarantors completing related-party tasks
audience.zh:
主要：房貸申請人

whyItMattered.en: Mortgage applicants had to coordinate web and paper steps, documents and related parties across disconnected channels, with no single view of what to complete or what would happen next.
whyItMattered.zh: 房貸申請人必須在彼此分離的管道中協調網站、紙本、文件與關係人步驟，缺少一個清楚說明待辦事項與下一步的完整流程。

businessImpact.en: Created one self-service application model aligning entry routes, applicant roles, consent, documents, progress and resumption for future App delivery.
businessImpact.zh: 建立一套自助申請模型，對齊申請入口、角色、同意、文件、進度與續填邏輯，作為後續 App 交付基礎。

entryRoutes.label: Direct application
entryRoutes.mindset: Already decided to apply and wants to begin without further persuasion.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Fast start, clear stages and no repeated confirmation.

entryRoutes.label: Calculator or comparison entry
entryRoutes.mindset: Has tested scenarios and wants to reduce decision risk.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Carry forward calculator context and avoid repeated entry.

entryRoutes.label: Relationship-manager referral
entryRoutes.mindset: Expects assistance and believes part of the application may already be prepared.
entryRoutes.experienceImplication: Preserve referral context, prefill known information and keep help visible.

userModel.problemStatement: Applicants had often chosen the bank before entering the application, but uncertainty about effort and outcome delayed or interrupted completion.
userModel.designVision: Turn mortgage application from a high-pressure decision flow into a predictable, controllable and reassuring experience.
designPrinciples: Lower the psychological cost of starting
Make the process and remaining work predictable
Explain why important fields are required and what they affect
Break the application into achievable steps
Preserve existing decisions, referral context and known data

channelProblem: The app was a new application capability rather than a simple visual refresh.

highFrictionAreas.evidence: Property, loan purpose, repayment model, related parties and consent were mixed in one high-drop-off area.
The page was long, interruption caused re-entry, and field labels or purposes were not sufficiently clear.
Applicants did not understand whether the banking-law relationship information was required, and marital-state logic could show irrelevant fields.
Terms were scattered across loan, related-person and confirmation pages and had to be accepted again on return.
Editing returned users to the start of the application area rather than the relevant section.
Requiring documents during the main application could block users who were applying during commutes or without paperwork at hand.
Result pages did not make next actions, missing documents or process status sufficiently clear.

applicantBranches: Existing mortgage customers and other deposit customers
Main applicants with or without co-borrowers or guarantors
Applicants with or without a financial credential
coreCapabilities: Preparation page with process, time and document expectations
Three entry routes with preserved context
New and existing customer identity flows
Application saving, session handling and resumption
State-based result, document and progress pages
resultStateModel: No financial credential + no related party

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Consent must be accepted again when an applicant re-enters.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Application data can be preserved, but consent cannot be treated as permanently retained.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: The guarantor application statement must be typed by the applicant.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: No fixed form or selectable sentence assembly could replace the applicant-entered declaration; guidance had to remain limited.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Applicants may not have supporting documents during mobile use.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Supporting files were separated from the core submission and surfaced in post-submit status and follow-up states.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: A financial credential changes required document states.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: Result and upload requirements branch according to credential availability.

stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.constraint: Related parties may need to install or open another banking app.
stakeholderAndRegulatoryConstraints.designEffect: SMS and email invitation, identity verification and return paths had to be modelled separately.

title.en: From one generic start to intent-aware application entry
title.zh: 從單一入口，到符合不同決策階段的三種申請方式

whatIDecided.en: Defined direct, calculator/comparison and relationship-manager entry routes, carrying forward known context while showing process stages, required preparation, expected time and the ability to resume.
whatIDecided.zh: 定義三種申請入口：直接申請、試算比較，以及由客戶關係經理協助申請；延續既有決策脈絡，並在進入流程前說明申請步驟、所需文件、預估時間與續辦方式。

whyThisChoice.en: Applicants had usually chosen the bank already; repeating persuasion or losing prior decisions increased uncertainty and delayed a high-stakes application.
whyThisChoice.zh: 用戶通常已完成銀行選擇；重新說服或遺失先前決策會增加不確定性，延後高壓的房貸申請。

evidence.en: The user analysis separated efficiency-and-control, decision-confirmation and continuity-and-trust needs across the three entry routes.
evidence.zh: 使用者分析顯示，三種入口分別對應效率與掌控、確認既有決策，以及延續關係與信任。

title.en: From a long restart-prone form to staged, purpose-led completion
title.zh: 從過長且容易重來的表單，到分段且說明目的的完成流程

whatIDecided.en: Reorganised the application into staged loan, personal, related-party, consent and confirmation work, adding purpose explanations, prefill, progress, section-level editing and save/resume behaviour.
whatIDecided.zh: 將申請重組為貸款資料、個人資料、關係人、同意條款與確認等分段任務，加入填寫目的、預填、進度、分區編輯與儲存續填。

whyThisChoice.en: The existing loan and basic-information pages mixed unrelated fields, created the highest interruption risk and forced applicants to repeat work after leaving.
whyThisChoice.zh: 既有貸款與基本資料頁面混合不相關欄位，是最高中斷風險區，也讓使用者離開後必須重複填寫。

content.en: Preserved application data and progress while requiring consent to be accepted again on return, protecting continuity without violating the consent constraint.
content.zh: 保留申請資料與進度，但回到流程時重新同意條款，以再次確認同意的成本，換取續填體驗與法規可行性。

tradeOff.chosen: Save application data and resume the unfinished stage
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Applicants repeat the consent step after returning
tradeOff.protectedValue: Regulatory validity without repeated data entry
tradeOff.constraint: Consent had to be accepted again on every re-entry

title.en: Convert paper-dependent steps into guided online self-service
title.zh: 將紙本依賴轉為引導式線上自助申辦

whatIDecided.en: Consolidated existing web and paper requirements, documents, applicant and related-party responsibilities, consent, progress and follow-up into one guided online flow, while keeping only legally or operationally necessary handoffs.
whatIDecided.zh: 將既有網站與紙本要求、文件、申請人與關係人責任、同意、進度及後續處理整合為一條引導式線上流程，只保留法規或營運上必要的交接。

whyThisChoice.en: Customers should be able to complete the application themselves without first understanding the bank’s fragmented channel and organisational boundaries.
whyThisChoice.zh: 顧客不應先理解銀行分散的通路與組織界線，才能自行完成房貸申辦。

content.en: Accepted explicit handoffs for legally or operationally required documents and related-party actions instead of pretending the entire mortgage process could be straight-through.
content.zh: 接受針對法規或營運必要文件與關係人操作保留明確交接，而不是假裝整個房貸流程都能完全自動直通。

tradeOff.chosen: Guided online self-service with explicit necessary handoffs
tradeOff.notChosen: Replicate the existing paper process online or claim fully straight-through processing
tradeOff.acceptedLoss: Some documents and related-party actions remain outside one uninterrupted session

tradeOff.chosen: Core submission followed by explicit post-submit tasks
tradeOff.notChosen: Block submission until all documents and related-party work were complete
tradeOff.protectedValue: Lower abandonment and a usable mobile self-service journey
tradeOff.constraint: Documents and other participants were not always available during the main session

summary.zh: 我主動建立並主持每週設計評議，將使用者研究、數據分析、同理心練習與早期設計討論，串接到工程、產品與利害關係人。

sessionTypes.evidence: Market and user research, GA events, behavioural and conversion tracking, Hotjar heat maps and recordings
Early feasibility and constraint feedback before formal iteration

testimonial.quote: It’s a great session and effort you make. I can see the team enjoy seeing all these insights, and engage better.

en: How do you build a critique culture?
How do you make research visible to engineering?
zh: 如何建立設計評議文化？
如何讓工程團隊看見研究證據？

sessionTypes_zh.evidence: 市場與使用者研究、Google Analytics 事件、行為與轉換追蹤，以及 Hotjar 熱點圖與操作錄影
以人物誌分群與使用者旅程進行討論
在正式迭代前先取得可行性與限制回饋

r65.target: Principal Product Designer and equivalent Staff / Lead IC roles
currentStrengths: Confirmed sole design ownership of a scaled Payment system
Evidence-led decisions, trade-offs and shipped craft

criticalRisks.issue: Booking and Payment contain strong figures whose statistical definitions are not yet explicit.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Confirm baseline, denominator, comparison window and whether each percentage is relative uplift, percentage-point change or index.

criticalRisks.issue: DBS demonstrates multi-market direction but still lacks a concrete durable outcome and confirmed Timeline.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Add operational adoption, cycle-time, error, escalation or dependency-reduction evidence.

criticalRisks.issue: Too many featured cases reduce decision speed and make the portfolio feel like a project archive.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Keep three primary cases on the homepage and route the rest through domain/search pathways.

criticalRisks.issue: The Cathay SIT project strengthens recency but currently proves delivery rather than launch or measurable impact.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Add production status, constraints and post-launch evidence when available.

criticalRisks.issue: Strategy evidence is stronger than visible implementation-quality proof in several cases.
criticalRisks.requiredAction: Pair each core case with one system diagram, one decision visual and one shipped interaction-quality visual.

summary.en: Regulated onboarding, lending, risk decisions and financial operations.
summary.zh: 受監管的初始申請、授信與風險決策，以及金融營運。

cardSubtitle.zh: 受監管的初始申請與授信

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from regulated application, advisory, review, exception, and remediation work across banking and investment products.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整銀行與投資產品中的申請、諮詢、審查、例外及補件經驗。

en: Eligibility and documentation requirements are difficult to understand before commitment
Application, review, and remediation states are fragmented across channels and teams
Risk controls create friction when decision ownership and next actions are unclear
zh: 資格與文件要求在正式申請前難以理解
申請、審查與補件狀態分散在不同通路與團隊
當決策責任與下一步不清楚時，風險控管會轉化為流程阻力

en: Translate policy, eligibility, and evidence requirements into visible decision states and guidance.
Structure journeys around information readiness and handoffs—not form completion alone.
Separate standard, exception, and remediation paths while keeping progress and responsibility traceable.
zh: 將政策、資格與證明資料要求轉化為可見的決策狀態與引導。
依資訊是否備妥與交接需求組織旅程，而不只以填完表單為目標。
分開標準、例外與補件路徑，同時維持進度與責任可追溯。

publicationBoundary.en: No client outcome, shipped-state, or metric is inferred from the domain synthesis.
publicationBoundary.zh: 此領域統整不推論客戶成果、上線狀態或數據。

summary.en: Internal systems that coordinate roles, rules, exceptions and accountable decisions.
summary.zh: 協調角色、規則、例外與可追責決策的企業內部系統。

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from internal case review, operational handoff, approval, exception, and remediation workflows.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整內部案件審查、營運交接、核准、例外與補件流程經驗。

zh: 分散且斷裂的營運流程
不清楚的核准路徑與決策責任
不一致的例外與補救處理方式

en: Define roles, authority, states, and ownership before shaping the interface.
Create traceable routing for approvals, exceptions, and decision ownership.
Turn fragmented operational knowledge into shared workflows and phased delivery plans.
zh: 在設計介面前，先定義角色、權限、狀態與責任。
為核准、例外與決策責任建立可追溯的處理路徑。
將分散的營運知識轉化為共享流程與分階段交付計畫。

publicationBoundary.en: The copy describes recurring workflow conditions and reusable methods, not implementation or operational-outcome claims.
publicationBoundary.zh: 文案只描述反覆出現的流程狀況與可重用做法，不主張實作或營運成果。

summary.en: Eligibility, reward, campaign and engagement systems that scale beyond one promotion.
summary.zh: 能超越單次活動、持續擴充的資格、獎勵、活動與參與系統。

cardSubtitle.zh: 會員機制、優惠券與遊戲化

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from a multi-year voucher programme, campaign journeys, shared incentive rules, engagement products, and supplier-funded mechanics.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整多年票券計畫、活動旅程、共享獎勵規則、互動產品與供應商出資機制。

en: Campaign mechanics are repeatedly rebuilt as one-off journeys
Eligibility, progress, and reward value are difficult to understand
New growth ideas introduce states and operating rules faster than teams can standardise them
zh: 活動機制反覆被做成一次性旅程
資格、進度與獎勵價值難以理解
成長構想帶來新狀態與營運規則的速度，超過團隊標準化能力

en: Separate stable incentive rules from campaign content and presentation.
Make relevance, eligibility, progress, expiry, and reward states visible across the journey.
Turn recurring campaign mechanics into reusable modules, shared definitions, and configurable operating rules.
zh: 將穩定的獎勵規則與活動內容及呈現分開。
在完整旅程中清楚呈現相關性、資格、進度、到期與獎勵狀態。
將反覆出現的活動機制轉化為可重用模組、共享定義與可設定的營運規則。

publicationBoundary.en: Voucher Center and Game Center remain subject to their project-level fact checks; the domain copy uses only patterns also supported by the broader voucher programme.
publicationBoundary.zh: Voucher Center 與 Game Center 仍需完成個別專案事實確認；領域文案只採用同時受到優惠券母計畫支持的模式。

summary.en: Online travel agency journeys shaped by booking conversion, market constraints and connected-trip dependencies.
summary.zh: 受預訂轉換、市場限制與跨產品旅程依賴影響的線上旅遊產品。

cardSubtitle.zh: 線上旅行社與全球預訂

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from global travel rollout and a multi-party online-auction transaction platform.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整全球旅遊產品上線與多方線上拍賣交易平台經驗。

en: Shared journeys break when market or participant constraints surface too late
Users lose trust when commitment and transaction states are ambiguous
Exceptions span multiple parties, markets, or support teams without clear ownership
zh: 市場或參與者限制太晚上浮時，共用旅程容易失效
承諾與交易狀態模糊時，使用者容易失去信任
例外橫跨多方角色、市場或支援團隊，卻缺乏明確責任

en: Map market, participant, content, and policy constraints before finalising the shared journey.
Make commitment, transaction, and exception states explicit at decision points.
Keep one core marketplace model while governing local, participant, and operational variations.
zh: 在共用旅程定案前，先盤點市場、參與者、內容與政策限制。
在關鍵決策點明確呈現承諾、交易與例外狀態。
保留單一核心市場模型，同時治理在地、角色與營運差異。

publicationBoundary.en: The online-auction project remains draft at project level; this domain copy avoids client, duration, shipped-state, and outcome claims.
publicationBoundary.zh: 線上拍賣專案在個案層級仍為草稿；此領域文案不涉及客戶、期間、上線狀態或成果主張。

summary.en: Omnichannel checkout, discovery, transactions and post-purchase operations.
summary.zh: 跨通路結帳、探索、交易與購買後營運。

synthesisBasis.en: Synthesised from online and in-store voucher discovery, checkout, payment, recovery, and post-purchase journeys.
synthesisBasis.zh: 統整線上與店內票券探索、結帳、付款、失敗復原與購後旅程。

en: Customers begin with products and baskets while savings are isolated in separate promotional surfaces
Eligibility, stackability, and final value are unclear before checkout
Digital, in-store, payment, and post-purchase states drift across channels
zh: 顧客從商品與購物車開始，但優惠被隔離在獨立促銷介面
資格、可否疊加與最終價值在結帳前不清楚
數位、店內、付款與購後狀態在不同通路間逐漸分歧

en: Surface relevant value where customers evaluate products and build baskets.
Explain applicability, conditions, savings, and recovery before payment.
Use shared state models across wallet, product, cart, checkout, in-store, and post-purchase journeys.
zh: 在顧客評估商品與建立購物車的時刻呈現相關價值。
在付款前說明適用性、條件、實際節省與失敗復原方式。
在票券錢包、商品、購物車、結帳、店內與購後旅程共用同一狀態模型。

publicationBoundary.en: The payment project remains under project-level verification; all three public patterns are independently supported by the verified voucher programme research.
publicationBoundary.zh: 付款專案仍需完成個案驗證；三項公開模式皆可由已驗證的優惠券母計畫研究獨立支持。

summary.en: Skill progression, guided practice, content discovery and playful learning.
summary.zh: 技能進程、引導式練習、內容探索與具趣味性的學習體驗。

synthesisBasis.en: Based on issues encountered in the current Bandzo learning-platform case.
synthesisBasis.zh: 以目前 Bandzo 學習平台案例中實際遇到的問題經驗為基礎。

en: Fragmented content makes progression and next steps difficult to understand
Personalisation depends on grading and content taxonomies that may not yet exist
Discovery, purchase, libraries, and practice become disconnected across devices
zh: 內容零散，使學習進程與下一步難以理解
個人化依賴可能尚未建立的分級與內容分類
探索、購買、個人譜庫與練習在不同裝置間彼此斷裂

en: Turn broad learning goals into a client-manageable content and progression framework.
Preserve useful personalisation with simple, explainable choices until richer taxonomies are ready.
Connect discovery, purchase, access, and practice through one cross-device structure.
zh: 將廣泛的學習目標轉化為客戶可自行管理的內容與進程框架。
在完整分類建立前，先以簡單且可理解的選擇保留實用個人化。
以單一跨裝置結構串連探索、購買、存取與練習。

publicationBoundary.en: Use the small basis note publicly. Do not present these observations as cross-project frequency evidence.
publicationBoundary.zh: 公開時必須顯示小字來源說明，不得把這些觀察寫成跨多個專案的頻率證據。

label.zh: 對齊利害關係人與營運團隊

fallbackRules: Use the requested locale, then English, then the first available value.
Never render an empty section heading.
Hide a section only when its source array is intentionally empty.
A missing referenced ID is an integration error and must be reported; do not silently create or replace content.
Do not infer project membership from free text.
interactionRules: Only one domain is active at a time.
Changing the selector updates the same focused detail canvas.
Featured work renders before supporting work.
Supporting work uses the existing related-project rail and canonical project popup.
The rail must support keyboard navigation and touch scrolling.

rankingRules: Use the highest matching signal once; repeated keywords do not multiply score indefinitely.
A project title or alias match outranks category-only matches.
Problem-intent and capability matches outrank domain-only matches.
Within equal scores, use the explicit domain project order and then portfolio feature order.
Professional projects rank before Explorations unless the query explicitly matches an Exploration title or capability.
Return one canonical project card per ID; never duplicate a project because it matches multiple domains.

noResultFallback: Show up to three relevant domains.
Do not return unrelated projects merely to fill space.

searchMatchingContract.domainAliasRule: Match current labels and legacyAliases, but display only the current canonical label.

title.en: Domain experience
title.zh: 領域經驗

namingDecision.reason: The public heading should be immediately understandable to hiring reviewers. Domain taxonomy remains managed internally.

internalPurpose.en: A relevance filter showing where I have applied system-level product design—not a list of company industries.
internalPurpose.zh: 用來快速判斷我在哪些產品領域具備系統級設計經驗，而不是公司產業清單。

travelClassification.reason: The case demonstrates an online travel agency booking journey and connected-trip product design, not a seller-listing marketplace model.

summary.en: Domain perspective
summary.zh: 領域觀點

learningPlatformBoundary.en: This synthesis is based on one released learning-platform case and reflects experience-based observations rather than a broad multi-project benchmark.
learningPlatformBoundary.zh: 目前整理自一個已上線的學習平台案例，呈現的是我在這次專案中的實際觀察，不代表所有學習產品都會遇到相同問題。

title.en: From manual saving to ready-to-use campaign inventory
title.zh: 從逐張儲存，到可直接使用的活動內容規模

ownershipDetail.en: Led the campaign-flow and state design; the preloaded-wallet release direction was aligned with PM, business and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導活動流程與狀態設計；Preloaded-wallet 上線方向則與產品經理、商務及工程共同對齊。

title.en: From generic failures to contextual recovery
title.zh: 從籠統失敗訊息，到情境式錯誤恢復

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led the phased recovery model with the PM and owned the interaction, state and message design.
ownershipDetail.zh: 與產品經理共同主導分階段復原模型，並負責互動、狀態與訊息設計。

title.en: From separated promotions to one contextual deal view
title.zh: 從分散的促銷資訊，到同一個商品情境中的優惠總覽

ownershipDetail.en: Led the hypothesis, prototype and product-page experience; business problem definition and rollout were aligned with business, PM and research.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導假設、原型與商品頁體驗；商業問題與推行則與商務團隊、產品經理及研究團隊對齊。

title.en: From permanently expanded instructions to progressive disclosure
title.zh: 從固定展開的說明，到漸進式揭露

ownershipDetail.en: Owned the interaction structure and shipped-state specification.
ownershipDetail.zh: 負責互動結構與已上線狀態規格。

title.en: From one generic Voucher page to condition- and channel-specific actions
title.zh: 從單一通用優惠券頁面，到依條件與通路對應操作

ownershipDetail.en: Led the condition and channel action model; feasibility and business rules were jointly resolved with PM and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導條件與通路操作模型；可行性與商業規則則與產品經理及工程團隊共同解決。

title.en: From a big-bang mechanic replacement to an incremental transition
title.zh: 從一次性全面替換，到漸進式轉型

ownershipDetail.en: Prepared the evidence, mechanism comparison and transition model; the long-term mechanism and phasing were programme decisions shared with product, business, operations and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理證據、機制比較與轉型模型；長期機制及分階段策略則由產品、商務、營運及工程共同決定。

title.en: From one universal mechanic to channel-specific reduction of redemption effort
title.zh: 從單一通用機制，到依通路降低兌換負擔

ownershipDetail.en: Led channel-constraint and customer-friction analysis; the final mechanism direction required shared business and engineering approval.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導通路限制與顧客阻力分析；最終機制方向需由商務與工程共同核准。

title.en: From choosing between density and detail to responsive component variants
title.zh: 從在資訊密度與完整細節間二選一，到響應式元件版本

ownershipDetail.en: Co-led early card exploration and translated cross-team feedback into responsive variants; formal component adoption was completed with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 共同主導早期卡片 探索，將跨團隊回饋轉化為響應式版本；正式元件採用則與設計系統團隊 共同完成。

title.en: From colour-coded meaning to colour supported by explicit information
title.zh: 從依賴顏色表意，到以明確資訊輔助顏色

ownershipDetail.en: Led evidence synthesis and information-priority recommendations; final visual semantics were aligned with the Design System team.
ownershipDetail.zh: 主導證據統整與資訊優先建議；最終視覺語意與設計系統團隊對齊。

title.en: From page-specific card designs to a configurable component contract
title.zh: 從各頁面獨立設計卡片，到可配置元件契約

ownershipDetail.en: Defined the cross-journey property and state requirements; component API and governance were resolved with Design System and engineering.
ownershipDetail.zh: 定義跨旅程屬性與狀態需求；元件 API 與治理則與設計系統及工程團隊共同解決。

title.en: From recurring Engineering clarification to rule-mapped Operations reuse
title.zh: 從反覆向工程團隊確認，到規則對應的營運團隊重用

ownershipDetail.en: Mapped operational rules and reusable states; final configuration ownership and governance were shared with operations, product, engineering and Design System.
ownershipDetail.zh: 整理營運規則與 可重用 狀態；最終 設定 責任歸屬 與治理則由營運團隊、產品團隊、工程團隊及設計系統共同承擔。

title.en: From one Voucher list to task-specific discovery and application
title.zh: 從單一優惠券列表，到依任務設計的探索與套用

title.en: From requested Search to evidence-led exploration
title.zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索

title.en: From full consolidation to a focused first release
title.zh: 從完整整合方向，到聚焦的第一階段上線

title.en: From a full Flash Deal platform to a staged Voucher POC
title.zh: 從完整限時優惠平台，到分階段優惠券前導驗證

title.en: From requested Search to evidence-led exploration
title.zh: 從商務團隊要求加入搜尋，到以證據優先支援探索

title.en: From a single direct entry to a central multi-game hub
title.zh: 從單一直接入口，到中央多遊戲中心

title.en: From a broad gamification vision to a focused concurrent-games release
title.zh: 從廣泛遊戲化願景，到聚焦多遊戲並行的首版

title.en: From a fixed game tile to an operator-configured listing
title.zh: 從固定遊戲卡片，到由營運團隊配置列表

title.en: From identical game cards to lifecycle-aware states
title.zh: 從狀態相同的遊戲卡片，到理解遊戲生命週期的狀態

title.en: From adding more layout density to clarifying urgency within the existing list
title.zh: 從增加版面密度，到在既有列表中強化急迫性

title.en: From one exception concept to distinct end-of-day and real-time operating models
title.zh: 從單一例外概念，拆分為日終監控與即時處理兩套營運模型

title.en: From report-centric work to role-based exception workbenches
title.zh: 從以報表為中心的工作方式，到依角色分流的例外案件工作台

title.en: From partial departmental views to one shared decision architecture
title.zh: 從各部門的片段視角，到一套共享的決策架構

title.en: From one suggested taxi to scanable option comparison
title.zh: 從單一建議計程車，到可快速掃描的選項比較

title.en: From repeated form entry to connected itinerary confirmation
title.zh: 從重複填寫表單，到連結旅程資訊的確認流程

title.en: From universal pickup promises to staged, context-aware guidance
title.zh: 從通用接送承諾，到分階段、具情境的接送指引

title.en: From automated skill recognition to a shippable five-level model
title.zh: 從自動程度辨識，到可上線的五級模型

title.en: From a third-party payment feature to a trusted transaction platform
title.zh: 從第三方付款功能，到值得信任的拍賣交易平台

title.en: From screen-by-screen rules to an end-to-end payment and logistics regulation
title.zh: 從逐頁規則，到端到端付款與物流規範

title.en: From separate UX and UI production to reusable patterns
title.zh: 從分離的 UX／UI 製作，到可重用的介面模式

title.en: From a fixed tablet orientation to a flexible consultation flow
title.zh: 從固定的平板引導，到彈性的房貸諮詢流程

title.en: From fragmented departmental inputs to one consultation structure
title.zh: 從分散的部門資訊，到一套共享的諮詢結構

title.en: From research handoff to a validated, system-aligned delivery
title.zh: 從研究交接，到經驗證且符合既有系統的設計交付

title.en: From separate loyalty and payment steps to one checkout identity
title.zh: 從分離的忠誠與付款步驟，到單一結帳識別

title.en: From ambiguous QR interactions to channel-specific guidance
title.zh: 從模糊的 QR 互動，到依通路設計的操作引導

title.en: From a successful payment screen to an end-to-end recovery and operations model
title.zh: 從付款成功畫面，到端到端恢復與營運模型

title.en: From one generic order list to labeled transaction histories
title.zh: 從單一通用訂單清單，到有清楚標籤的交易紀錄

title.en: From isolated complaints to an end-to-end opportunity model
title.zh: 從零散抱怨，到端到端機會模型

title.en: From late account constraints to upfront routing and resumable stages

contentWritingStandard.purpose: Keep public portfolio copy clear, credible, scannable, and relevant to Principal Product Designer hiring.

style: Lead with the change, decision, or outcome.
Use active voice and specific verbs.
Avoid stacked nouns, internal acronyms, and generic UX language.
Use product and operational terminology only when it improves precision.
使用台灣產品、金融與營運團隊自然使用的繁體中文。
先寫改變、決策或結果，再補充方法。
句子短而直接，避免英文語序與逐字翻譯。
有清楚中文對應時，不在中文句子中混用英文。
公司名、正式產品名與核准縮寫可保留英文。
避免中國大陸慣用詞與空泛管理術語。

sectionPurpose.title: Communicate the transformation.
sectionPurpose.atAGlance: Summarise role, problem, action, scale, and outcome.
sectionPurpose.whyItMattered: Explain business urgency without describing the solution.
sectionPurpose.businessImpact: State the durable business or operating change.
sectionPurpose.keyInterventionMap: Show where the system, workflow, or experience changed.

projectCardCopyStandard.purpose: A shorter project-card title optimised for fast scanning and balanced line breaks. It does not replace the full transformation title on the project detail page.

english.rule: Lead with the product or system change.

rules: Keep the central product noun phrase intact.
Avoid ending a line with a modifier that belongs to the following noun.
Prefer one clear verb and one product outcome.
Do not force the full From–to construction into compact project cards.
